text.body:
tripurāsārasamuccayaḥ [tantraśāstram ] śrīnāgabhaṭṭaviracitaḥ| śrīgovindācāryyakṛtavyākhyayā samalaṅkṛtaḥ|
paṇḍitakulapatinā, vi , e upādhidhāriṇā śrījīvānandavidyāsāgarabhaṭṭacāryyeṇa saṃskṛtaḥ prakāśitaśca|
dvitīyasaṃskaraṇam| kālikātānagare kalikātā yantre mudritaḥ| iṃ 1897|
tripurāsārasamuccayaḥ|
prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ|
prahvaprācīnavarhiḥ pramukhasuravarānīkakoṭīkaroṭiśliṣṭaspaṣṭenṭra nīlāmalamaṇi madhupaśreṇijuṣṭaṃ kṛṣīṣṭa | śrīpādāmbhojayugmaṃ nakhamuṃkhavilasadraśmikiñjalkapuñjam śiñjambhañjīrahaṃsasīmukharitamaniśaṃ maṅgalaṃ vo bhavānyāḥ|| 1||
natvā śaṅkara caraṇaṃ śrīmadgīvindaśarmaṇā| tripurāsāraṭīkeyaṃ racyate sāradṛśvanā||
tasyai diśe satatamañjalireṣa pauṣpaḥ prakṣipyate mukharitī madhurairdvirephaiḥ| jāgartti yatra bhagavān gurucakravarttī viśvīdayapraṇanāṭaka sūtradhāraḥ||
śrīmadraguruparameśvarapadāravinda praṇihita bhaktibharāvanamra śirasā paramācāryya parasparaprasādalabdhavijñānena sarvāgamapārāvārapāragatena vijñānadaiśikenācāryya nāgabhaṭṭhena viracitasya tripurāsārasamuccayasya sampradāyadīpikā vyākhyā ārabhyate | tatra sadācāra numitaśrutibodhanaṃ paradevatāsmaraṇapūrvakamāśīrlakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyaśikṣārtha nibadhnannāha prahvaprācīna varhirityādi| bhavānyāḥ śrīpādāmbhojayugmaṃ vo yuṣmākaṃ maṅgalaṃ kṛṣīṣṭa karotu| kīdṛśaṃ prahva prācīna varhiḥ pramukha suravarānīka koṭīra koṭiśliṣṭa spaṣṭendra nīlāmala maṇi madhu paśreṇī juṣṭaṃ prācīna varhiḥ prācyadhipastat pramukhāstat pradhānā ye prahvā namrī bhūtā ye devaśreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ yaḥ samūhaḥ tasya mukuṭasambandhī vyaktī bhūto yaḥ indra nīlāmalamaṇiḥ sa eva bhramaraḥ tasya paṃktyā śreṇyā yuktam | ambhojadyotanamāha nakha mukhetyādi | nakhānāṃ mukhe vilasat yaṭraśmi tadeva kiñjalkasamūho yasya tādṛśam | punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ śiñjanmañjīraṃhaṃsīmukharitaṃ śabdāyamānasa || 1||
pṛ0 2) bhaktyā gurorbhavapayonidhisetuhetūn śrīpādapadmayugareṇu kaṇān praṇamya| lambodarañca kathayāmi gurūpadiṣṭa mārādhanakramamahaṃ kulanāyikāyāḥ|| 2|| snātvā yathāvidhi vidhautakarānanāṅghiḥ ācamya samyagamalāmbarayajña sūtraḥ | prāgānano dhanadadigvadano'tha vāpi baddhāsano gaṇapatiñca guruñca natvā|| 3|| saṃyojya jīvamatha durgama madhyanāḍa़īmārgeṇa puṣkaraniviṣṭaśive susūkṣme| haṃsena dehamamarendra purogatena sārdvendunā bhasitasāda vidadhīta mantro || 4||
pṛ0 3) sāsyādinātha marutā'panayannaśeṣam tad bhasma rāśima khilaṃ bhuvanaṃ sakena | saṃplāvayan balabhidā paricintayet svamātmānamambhasi ghaṭena savindukena || 5|| tato vṛhad bud buda madhya varttisphu ratprabhāmaṇḍalamaṇla bhājam| dhyātvā tadantarbhuvanānya mūni vicintayed bhūtala metadantaḥ|| 6|| smitaprasavaśobhitaṃ navamanindyagandhotkaṭam kadamba vana muccakairiha samantataścintayet | tadantarapi maṇḍitaṃ.maṇigaṇairmahāmaṇḍapam hiraṇmaya mupāñcitaṃ dyumaṇimaṇḍalābhaprabham| 7| caturdvāropetaṃ maṇimaya catustoraṇayutam sphu rattārānāthadyutisitavitānāṅkamupari|
iṣṭadevatāṃ namaskṛtya gurunamaskāramāha bhaktyā iti | guroḥ pādapadmareṇukaṇān praṇamya lambodarañca praṇamya kulanāyikāyā ārādhanavidhiṃ kathayāmi| kīdṛśān tān saṃsāra eva payonidhirdustaratvāt taduttaraṇe setuhetūn līlātaraṇahetūna| ārādhanakramaṃ kīdṛśaṃ guruṇopadiṣṭaṃ vinā āgamajñānānarthakyaprasaṅgāt| tasmād gurudevatayoraikyaṃ karttavyam| taduktaṃ yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau| tasyaite kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante mahātmana iti || 2|| gurudevatādi namaskṛtya upāsanāprakāramāha snātvetti| nadyādau yathāvidhi snātvā sandhyāvandanādikaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi ācamya prakṛṣṭanirmalayajñasūtraḥsan pūrvābhimukhaḥ yathāyogyaṃ mṛdvāsane svastikāsane vā upaviśya vāme guruṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇeśaṃ madhye iṣṭadevatāṃ natvā vakṣyamāṇabhūtaśuddhi vidaśvīta| durgamamadhyanāḍa़ī mārgeṇa suṣumnāntarvarttinā citrāmārgeṇa puskaraniviṣṭāśive sahastradala kamalakūṭastha paramātmani jīvaṃ jīvātmānaṃ saṃyojya chatra grandhāntara svara savaśājvaturviśati tatvānyapi tatra nayeta| haṃsena haṃsa iti mantreṇa amarendra purogatena sārdvendunā amarendro lakāraḥ tat purogatorephaḥ dmarḍvendurvindustena ramiti mantreṇa svakaṃ svaśarīraṃ bhasitasāt bhasmasāt kuryyāt bhasmībhūtaṃ svaśarīramiti cintayedityarthaḥ|| 3|| 4|| sāsyādinātha maruteti| sāsyaṃ visarjanīyastasyādirvinduḥ marut yakāraḥ tena yamiti vāyuvaujena bhasmarāśiṃ nirākurvan sānusvāreṇa balabhidvījena lakāreṇa sakalaṃ bhuvanaṃ ptāvitaṃ kurvan svamātmānaṃ amṛtamayāmbhasi sānusvāreṇa ghaṭena cintayet| ghaṭaśabdenādhiṣṭhāna lakṣaṇayā jalaṃ lakṣitam| tena ca tadvījena vakāreṇa sānusvāreṇāmṛtamayāmbhasi ātmānaṃ dhyāyedityarthaḥ|| 5|| tat iti | tadanantaraṃ tajjalavegamadhyavartti sphuraddīptisamūhaṃ brahmaṇḍaṃ dhyāyet| tadabhyantare caturdaśa bhuvanāni teṣāmadhyantare bhūmitalaṃ vicintya tanmadhye kadambavanaṃ cintayet| kīdṛśaṃ kadambavanaṃ prakāśakusumaśobhitaṃ navaṃ nūtanam anindyagandhoskaṭaṃ spṛhaṇīya saurabhaśāli sarvato mahatkadambavanaṃ tadvanābhyantare maṇibhirbhūṣitaṃ sauvarṇa mahāmaṇḍapaṃ sūryyamaṇḍalābhadīptaṃ cintayet || 6|| 7|| kīdṛśaṃ caturdvārairyuktaṃ maṇimayaiśvaturbhistīraṇaiḥ sahitam | sphurantī yā śaśi
pṛ0 4) sthitau dvāre dvāre ruciramaṇimālyāmbaradharo gaṇeśakṣetreśau ca saparikarau yasya mahitau|| 8|| pūrvadvāri savāhanaṃ harihayaṃ tasyaiva yāmye yamam pāścātye varuṇaṃ tathaiva tadudagdvāre kuveraṃ sthitam| saṅgītādirataista dantaramarastrīṇāṃ gaṇairākulam dhyāyet samyaganākulena manasā gandharva mukhyairapi|| 9|| tasya madhyagatasiṃhaviṣṭare padma maṣṭadalaśobhitaṃ tataḥ| udyaduṣṇakaramaṇḍalojjavalaṃ cintayedaruṇacārukeśaram|| 10|| tatkarṇikopari kapañjamamambuturyya yuktaṃ manusvaratadantayutaṃ vidhāya| pretaṃ dhiyā tadupari tridaśendravandyām dhyāyetriloka jananīṃ dayitāṃ purāreḥ|| 11||
pṛ0 5) suruciranāsikāṃ sunayanāṃ sukapolatalāmaruṇa jaṭākalāpakalitāmalacandrakalām | vilasadaṣṭamīndukamanoya lalāṭa tadām pariṇata śāradendurucirānana paṅkaruhām|| 12||
bandhūkāruṇa kāntidanta vasanā muttuṅgavṛttastanīm yuktāṃ bālamṛṇālanāla lalitairbhavyaiścaturbhirbhujaiḥ | tatkālasmita padma patra vilasannetratrayodbhāsitām tārādhīśadineśa kuṇḍala dharāmullāsicillīlatīm || 13|| valitrayodbhāsita dīnamadhyāṃ pradakṣiṇāvartta gabhauranābhīm | kasturikākarda malekhayeva virājamānāmapi romarājyā|| 14|| smita nava bandhujīva kusumāruṇa sadvasanām maṇimayarasanākalāpa kalitorunitambataṭām| karikarapauvaroruyugalāṃ varahaṃsagatim caraṇa tala prabhāvijita paṅkaja garbhadalām || 15||
dīptistadvat sitena vitānenīpari cidnaṃ yasya maṇḍapasya tam | pratidvāraṃ saparivārau gaṇeśakṣetrapālau sthitāviti cintayet || 8|| pūrveti | tasya maṇḍapasya pūrvadvāri airāvata sahita mindraṃ dhyāyet| dakṣiṇadvāri mahiṣa sahitaṃ yamam| paścimadvāri makara sahitaṃ baruṇam | uttaradvāri narayānaṃ kuveraṃ dhyāyet | savāhanānukarṣi sakalānvayi yadabhyantaraṃ nṛtyādirataiḥ amarastrī samūhaiḥ vyāptaṃ cintayet| gandharva kulaira pyākulaṃ cintayet|| 9|| tasyeti| tasya maṇḍapasya madhyasthitasiṃhāsane aṣṭadalapadmaṃ cinyayet | kīdṛśaṃ padmaṃ prātaḥ kālīnasūryya vimbatulyam aruṇamityarthaḥ tathā aruṇaṃ lohitaṃ manohāri ca kiñjalkaṃ yasya|| 10|| taditi | tasyāṣṭadala karṇikāyā upari hesauṃ ityāsamavījaṃ vidhāya taduḍvāraṇa prakāramāha kaṃ jalaṃ tadvījaṃ vakāraḥ tatpañcamī hakāraḥ ambu rakāraḥ tatturthyaḥ sakāraḥ tena yuktaṃ manavaścaturdaśa tadupalakṣita saṃkhyakasvara aukāraḥ tadantaḥ dyaṅkāraḥ tābhyo yuktam etāvatā hesauṃ iti bhavati| etadevāsanavījaṃ devyāḥ tadupari presaṃ śivarupaṃ vicintya tasyopari trilokamātaraṃ haravallabhāṃ dhyāyet || 11|| dhyeya devo svarupamāha suruciretyādi | aruṇa jaṭāsamūha nibaddha candra ṣoḍa़śa bhāgāṃ tathā pradakṣiṇā varttaga bhīranābhīṃ pradakṣiṇa āvarttaḥ bhūmiryasyāḥ tādṛśyā nābhyā yuktaṃ kasturikā kardama rekhā tulyayā romarājyā yuktaṃ smita nava bandhūka kusumāruṇa sadvasanāṃ vikasitabandhūka kusumāruṇavastrāṃ maṇimayarasanā kalāpa kalitīrunitambataṭāṃ maṇimayakṣudraghaṇṭikāsambandha kaṭideṇaṃ karikarapīvarīruhasta yugalāṃ hastisthūlahastajaghanāṃ caraṇa tala prabhāviji tapaṅka jagarbhadalāṃ garbho'bhyantaraṃ praṇatapurandara pramukhalaṃkhanikāyalasanmaṇi mukuṭa prabhāpaṭala pāṭalitāṅghi yugāṃ | namrī bhūtendropa krama deva samūha dīpyanmaṇi mukuṭa dīpti samūha śvetarakta padadvayāṃ maṇīnāṃ nānāvidhatvādīpteḥ pāṭalatvam | murucireti| atimanochāri sadhyākālīnāmbu dadīpti samūhajuṣā sevitena nijatanu tejasā svaśarīra tejasā kavalitaṃ vyāptaṃ digvalayañja yayā tām| divyāmbu bāheti divyamegha samūhodaranirgatairmuktāphalairviracitāṃ rucirāṃ manohāriṇīṃ ekāvalīm | ko mastakastasyānte gale bahantoṃ athavā kānte kamanīye gale| pāśaṅkaśe ūrḍvavāmadakṣa hastābhyāṃ varābhaye adhaḥ- karābhyāṃ dadhānām| ratna prakāṇḍa racitābharaṇīrāmāṃ ratna prakāṇḍaṃ ratna śreṣṭhastena
pṛ0 6) praṇatapurandarapramukhalekha nikāyasan maṇi mukuṭa prabhāpaṭala pāṭalitāṅghi yugām| surucira sāndhyā vāridhara kānti kalā pajuṣā nija tanu tejasā kavalitāmbara digbalayām|| 16||
divyāmbu vāhanivahodaramuktavṛtta muktāphalaurviracitāṃ rucirāṃ vahantīm| ekāvalīmamala komala kānti yuktām kānte gale ca haricandana liptagātrām|| 17||
pāśāṅkuśābhayavarodyatapāṇipadmām ratna prakāṇḍaracitābharaṇābhirāmām| spnerānanāṃ ruciradantamarīcivīci dhautāruṇā dharadalāṃ suravṛnda vandyām|| 18||
svaikyena tribhuvanamātaraṃ mṛḍa़ānīm dhyātvaivaṃ nijakulakāmadhenumenām| hṛtpadmaṃ punarapi jīvamānayet svam ākāśāmbhoruha kuṭīra niviṣṭahaṃsāt || 19||
iti śrīnāgabhaṭṭaviracite tripurāsārasamuccaye prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ||
racitāni yānyābharaṇāni tairabhirāmāṃ manīharām | ruciradantamarīcivīcidhautāruṇā dharadalāṃ rucirā manoharā ye dantānāṃ marīcayo raśmayasteṣāṃ vīcibhistaraṅgarupairdhautaṃ nirmalīkṛtam aruṇādharapallavaṃ yasyāḥ tām | suravṛndairdevavṛndairvandyāṃ sevitām|| svaikyeneti enāṃ tribhuvana jananīṃ bhavānīṃ svaikyena ātmaikyena vicintya punarapi jīvātmānam ākāśa padmakuṭīraniviṣṭa paramātmanaḥ sakāśāt svīyaṃ hṛtkamalam dhānayet | haṃsa iti mantreṇa caturviśati tatvānyapi svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ nayet ityanya grandha svarasāt| iti bhūtaśuddhiḥ|| 12- 19||
dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ|
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhikā vadhikara dvandvāṅgulīṣu nyaset vāṇān ṣañca gurūpadiṣṭa vidhinā brūmo vayaṃ tāniha| adrīśo mukhavṛttavahni sahita stvādyaṃ sadaṇḍastri mūrttyākrāntānanavṛttameva khalu tadvījaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhavet || 1||
mukhāntasthitaṃ devarājādhirūḍha़ṃ savāmekṣaṇaṃ vaktrapūrveṇa yuktam| bhapūrvaṃ savṛtrāriṣaṣṭha svarārdvakṣapeśaṃ katuryyaṃ kapūrveṇa yuktam|| 2||
nyasyāṅgānyapi cāṅgulīṣu karayoḥ sthityā kalānyāsakam kuryyāt sādhaka puṅgavo bhagapaṃraṃ māyā kulāntaṃ kramāt| vījānāṃ trayamarddha candra sahitaṃ vinyasya mūrdhni svake sānantaṃ mukhavṛttake kagatakaṃ saṃvartta kaṃ vinyaseta|| 3||
evaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāya paradevatāsvarupamātmānaṃ buddhā vakṣyamāṇaṃ nyāsajālaṃ vidadhate ityāha aṅguṣṭhetyādinā| aṅguṣṭhopakramakaṃ kaniṣṭhāntaṃ hastadvayāṅgu līṣu vāṇān nyaset| te ca drāvaṇakṣībhaṇavaśīkaraṇa māraṇa mohanāḥ pañca vāṇāḥ teṣāṃ vījānyāha kramaśaḥ | adrīśa iti | adrīśodakāraḥ mukhavṛntaḥ nyasta vyākāraḥ vahnīrephaḥ tābhyāḥ sahito'drīśa ādyaṃ vījaṃ bhavet sadaṇḍaḥ sānusvāraḥ tena ṭrāmiti vījaṃ bhavati tadeva vījaṃ trimūrttyā īkāreṇa ākrāntam anena sthānaṃ yasya tat dvitīyavījaṃ bhavati etāvatā drīmiti bhavati || 1||
tṛtīya vījamuḍvarati mukheti | mukhe nyastata iti mukhaṃ visargaḥ tadantaḥ kakāraḥ tadu़ḍvareta| kīdṛśaṃ devarāja indraḥ tadvījaṃ lakāraḥ tadupari sthitaṃ vāmacakṣuṣi nyasyate ikāraḥ tat sahitaṃ vakte nyasyate yo visargaḥ tat pūrvo vinduḥ tena yuktam etāvatā kīmiti vījaṃ bhavati| caturtha muddharati bhapūrvo vakāraḥ vṛtrāriṇā lakāreṇa ṣaṣṭhasvara ūkārasvena ca sahitam etāvatā lvūmiti vījaṃ bhavati| pañcama vīja muddharati kaṃ jalaṃ tadvījaṃ vakāraḥ tatturīyaḥ sakāraḥ kakārapūrvo visargaḥ tena sahitam etāvatā sa iti bhavati| sarvatra vījaṃ bhavedityanuṣaṅgaḥ|| 2||
nyasyeti| sthitinyāsoktavidhinā ubhayakarāṅgulīṣu karatalayośya vinyasena |
pṛ0 8) sūkṣmādīṃścaturo yuge nayanayo rnyasyettataḥ śrotrayoḥ sārddhendun svakapolayorbhṛ guyugaṃ ghrāṇadvayenānvitam | candrārddhāṅkitamastakañca civuke śvetadvayaṃ vinyaset paścādgaṇḍayugānvitaṃ śaśikulopetottamāṅgaṃ budhaḥ|| 4||
danta paṃkti yugale vakadvayaṃ sendukhaṇḍaradana cchadadvayam | oṣṭhayorghaṭayugaṃ tato nyaseddanta yugmamukha pūrvasaṃyutam|| 5||
rasaṃ nābhāvarddhoḍupayutamamuṃ nyasya pavanam nyasenmantrī sāntya svaramapi śikhāyāmavahitaḥ| pṛ0 9) kalānyāsaṃ kurvannamumiha yathoktena vidhinā ciraṃ jīvatyadnā vigatagadamṛtyuḥ sukhamiha|| 6||
paścādde he kevalā mātṛkā vā vinyastavyā rudraśaktyānvitā vā | vidyānyāsaṃ sādhakendra stato'ṅga nyāsaṃ cāsya nyāsapūrvaṃ vidadhyāt|| 7||
vidyānyāsaṃ mūlamantrasya varṇaiḥ kuryyānmantrī vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa| ādyaṃ vījaṃ mūrdhni guhye dvitīyaṃ tārttīyaṃ vā vinyaset hṛtpradeśe|| 8||
savyāpa savyekṣaṇayorlalāṭe vījatrayaṃ śrotrayuge ca vakte| aṃśadvaye cāpi ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vījatrayaṃ kūrparayośca nābhau|| 9||
nyāso hi brahmacārī gṛhī mumukṣurityadhikāribhedāt sṛṣṭi sthiti saṃhārātmanā trividhaḥ| madhyamādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyaset prāhurimāṃ sthitim | aṅguṣṭhāntaṃ kaniṣṭhādi sṛṣṭinyāso'bhidhīyate| aṅguṣṭādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ saṃhāranyāsa īritaḥ| nābhyādi keśapādāntaṃ sthityā dehe nyaset sudhīḥ| keśādipādaparyyantaṃ sṛṣṭinyāso'bhidhīyate| pādādi keśaparyyantaṃ saṃhāranyāsa īritaḥ| evaṃ yathādhikāraṃ vinyasya vakṣyamāṇa kalānyāsaṃ kuryyāt| tamevāha bhaga ekāraḥ tat param aikāraḥ māyā bhuvaneśī vījaṃ hīṃ| kulāntaṃ kulavidyāyāḥ antaṃ sauḥ iti| sāmpradāyikāstu akulāntam akulo'kāraḥ tasyāntaṃ kṣakāra iti vadanti| etadvījatrayaṃ svake mūrdhni nyaset| sāmāntaṃ mukhavṛtta ke iti saṃvarttakaṃ kṣakāraḥ sānantam ākārayuktaṃ kṣagataṃ ke śirasigataṃ vindurityarthaḥ | tena kṣāmiti mukhavṛttake nyaset|| 3||
sūkṣmādīniti| sūkṣma īkāraḥ sa eva ādiryeṣāṃ te sūkṣmādayaḥ sārdrendūn savindukānityarthaḥ| tena iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ iti nayanayīḥ śrītrayośca nyaset| svakapīlayorbhṛguyugaṃ sakārayugaṃ ghrāṇadvayenānvitaṃ ṛ ṛ ityanenānvitaṃ sṛṃ sṛṃ * ityarddha candrānvitaṃ svakapolayornyaset | civuke śvetadvayaṃ śvetaḥ ṣakāraḥ gaṇḍayugaṃ ḷ ḹ śaśikulaṃ vinduḥ vindu śiraskaṃ tena ghṛṃ ghṛṃ iti vījadvayaṃ civukapārśva yornyaset|| 4||
dantapaṃktiyugale vakadvayaṃ śakāradvayam| indukhaṇḍovinduḥ savindukaṃ vadanacchada dvayam e ai vindu sahita mirtyyaḥ || tena śeṃ śaiṃ iti dantapaṅttayo rnyaset| oṣṭhayo rghaṭayugaṃ ghaṭo vakārastadvadvayaṃ dantayugam o au mukhaṃ visarjanīyaḥ tat pūrvo vinduḥ savindukamityarthaḥ| tena roṃ rauṃ iti vījadvayaṃ oṣṭayo rnyaset|| 5||
rasaṃ nābhāviti | rasīrephaḥ arddhoḍa़upī vinduḥ tena ramiti nābhau nyaset | pavanaṃ yakāraḥ antyasvaro visarjanīyaḥ| tena yamiti śirasi nyaset| avadvitaḥ sāvadhānaḥ iti ṣoḍa़śakalā nyaset| nyāsa phalamāha - amuṃ nyāsaṃ kūrvan uktavidhinā asau sādhakaḥ rogamṛtyurahitaḥ sukhaṃ yathā syāttathā adyātma tattvena jīvati|| 6||
ṣoḍa़śakalānyāsānantaraṃ mātṛkāṃ kevalāṃ rudraśaktyānvitāṃ vā yathā sthānaṃ nyaset | rudrāḥ śrīkaṇṭhādayaḥ śaktayaḥ pūrṇodaryyādayaḥ| nyāsasthānāni śāradāyām| lalāṭa mukhavṛttākṣiśrutighrāṇeṣu gaṇḍayoḥ| oṣṭhadantottamāṅgāsyadoḥ pat sandhyagrakeṣu ca| pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhato nābhau jaṭhare hṛdayeṃ'śake| kakudyaṃse ca hṛtpūrva pāṇipādayuge tathā| jaṭharānanayornyasyenmātṛkārṇān yathākramāt| tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjā śukrātmakān viduḥ| yādīn hādīn nyasedātmaparamajñāna pūrvakān| prayogastu aṃ śrīkaṇṭhapūrṇodarībhyāṃ namī lalāṭe ityādi | tato'nantaraṃ vidyānyāsaṃ kuryyāt || 7||
vidyānyāsa prakāramāha vidyeti| kathyamāna prakāreṇa mūlamantrākṣarairvidyā nyāsaṃ kuryyāt | prathamaṃ vījaṃ mastake dvitīyaṃ gude tṛtīyaṃ hṛdaye nyaset | ityekī nyāsaḥ|| 8||
savyeti | vāmadakṣiṇa netrayorādyaṃ dvayaṃ tṛtīyaṃ lalāṭe anyaḥ | karṇayuge vakte caika nyāsaḥ| aṃ sadvaye pṛṣṭhe ca eko nyāsaḥ | jānuyuge nābhau ca eko nyāsaḥ|
pṛ0 10) vījatrayeṇaiva ṣaḍa़ānanāni prakalpayedūrddha mukhādi vidvān| aṅgāni mūlena ca guhyanābhihṛdvaktamūrddhasvapi pañca vāṇān|| 10||
lalāṭadeśe vadane hṛdi sve nābhau ca guhye'pi ca vinyasettān | trailokya saṃkṣobhaṇa dṛṣṭaśaktīn pañcāpi kāmānapi vakṣyamāṇān || 11||
iha kāmarājamanmatha kandarpa makara ketanāścāpi | nāmabhiretairditā mano bhavenānvitāḥ kramaśaḥ|| 12||
kapañcamaṃ śucinanānta saṃyutam savāmaddak pavana guṇānvitaḥ karaḥ| ravisvaro harihayaviṣṇuṣaṣṭhavada balaṃ tatastara uparānvito bhṛguḥ|| 13||
pṛ0 11) teṣāṃ śiraḥsu vidadhīta budho'rddhacandrā nevaṃ mayā nigaditāḥ khalu pañca kāmāḥ| puṃsaḥ smarānanudinaṃ nyasataḥ svadehe lokatrayaṃ bhavati tasya mano'nuvṛttiḥ|| 14||
atha trilokārcita śāsanāyā vakṣyāmi vīja trayamambikāyāḥ| gopta vyametatat kuladharma vidbhirāmuṣṭahetornija siddhaye ca || 15||
kāntādibhūtapadagaṃ kagatārddha candram dantānta pūrva jaladhisthita varṇayuktam | etajja pannaravaro bhuvi vāgbhavādyam vācāṃ sudhāra samucāṃ labhate sa siddhim || 16||
kāntāntaṃ kulapūrvapañcamayutaṃ netrānta dantānvitam kāmākhyāṃ gaditaṃ japanmanu varaṃ sākṣājjagata kṣobhakṛt|
ūrddhādho dakṣiṇa vakte ca ekī nyāsaḥ| tathā vāmāparamadhya vakteṣu ekaḥ| evaṃ saptamūla vidyāṃ nyasediti || 9|| vījatrayeṇeti | mūla mantra vījaistri bhirdvi ruktaiḥ ṣaḍa़ṅgāni prakalpayet| vaduktaṃ tripurārṇave ūrddhādi paravaktāntaṃ vidyānyāsaṃ samācaret | ūrddhe pūrve tathā vāme pṛṣṭhe dakṣe tathā kramāditi | guhyanābhīti| guhyanābhi hṛdayānana mūrddhasu pūrvokta vāṇa pañcakaṃ nyasediti|| 10||
kāmanyāsamāha lalāṭeti | vakṣyamāṇān pañca kāmān lalāṭādiṣūkta sthāneṣu nyaset|| 11||
tān kathayati iheti| ete pañca kāmāḥ nāmabhiḥ kathivāḥ|| 12|| eṣāṃ vījāni kathayati kapañcamamiti| kaṃ jalaṃ tadvījaṃ vakāraḥ talpañcamī hakāraḥ śucinā agni vījena repheṇa nayanāntena īkāreṇa ca yuktaṃ tena hnīmiti bhavati| iti prathamavījam| vāmadṛk īkāraḥ pavano yakāraḥ tadṛguṇākṣaraṃ tṛtīyākṣaraṃ lakāraḥ karaḥ kakāraḥ | kakāra lakāre kāraiḥ kāmākhyaṃ vījaṃ dvītīyam| ravisvaraḥ dvādaśasvaraḥ aikāraḥ tṛtīyaṃ vījam | harihayo lakāraḥ viṣṇuḥrakāraḥ tataḥ ṣaṣṭhasvara ūkāraḥ| valaṃ vakāraḥ vakāralakāro kāraiścaturtham | etāvanā lvūmiti| tara itri svarupaṃ uparaḥ īkāraḥ bhṛguḥ sakāraḥ sakārata kārarephekāraiḥ pañcamaṃ tena strīmiti|| 13|| teṣāṃ śiraḥ su vidadhola budho'rddhacandrāniti| etāni vījāni pratyeka vindubhiḥkāmarājamanmatha kandarpa makara ketana mano bhavanāmabhiḥ saṃyojya nyasedityarthaḥ|| 14| 15|| kāntādibhūta padagamiti| kakaro'nu svāraḥ sa evānto yasyaukārasya tasyādi bhūtā padagam ādi caturdaśa padagam akāraḥ yatrākāntī visargastasyādibhūtapadagam ādau sthitaṃ yat svarupamakāraḥ tamuḍaret| kagatārddhacandraṃ ke mastake gato'rddhacandro yasya tādṛśaṃ śirogatānusvāramityarthaḥ| danta okāraḥ tadanta aukāraḥ tat pūrvajaladhisthita varṇa yuktaṃ tat prātilomyena caturthamakṣaraṃ ekāraḥ kagatārddhacandraṃ savindukamityarthaḥ | etaiḥ sahitāyāṃ vṛddhau satyāṃ aiṃ iti vāgbhavākhyo mahān mantra uddhataḥ| eta dvāgbhavanāmakaṃ vījaṃ japran aśeṣāmṛtamayīṃ vāk siddhiṃ labhate| gadyāpadyā śivānī asmādbhavatīti vāgbhavamiti prathamaṃ mūlamantravījam || 16|| dvitīyaṃ vījamuddharati kāntāntamiti| ke mastake nyasyata iti kaṃ vinduḥ tasyānto visarjanīyaḥ aḥ iti tadantaḥ kakāraḥ | kulaṃ sakāraḥ tat pūrvapañcamaṃ tat prātilomyena pañcamī lakāraḥ tadanta īkāraḥ danto vinduḥ kakāralakārekāreṇa etavatā kīmiti
pṛ0 12) dantāntena yutaṃ sadanti sakalaṃ sammohanākhyaṃ kulam sidhyatyasya guṇāṣṭakaṃ svararatā siddhiśca nityaṃ japet || 17||
ṛṣirdakṣiṇāmūrti saṃjño mahatmā bhavecchanda etasya mantrasya paṅktiḥ| sarasvatya cintya prabhāvā pradiṣṭā badhai rdevatā devavṛndārcitāṅdhiḥ|| 18||
amuṣya mantrasya radānta yuktajam vījaṃ sadantaṃ nakulīśapūrvam| śaktistu sākhaṇḍala karṇapūrvam sahārddha jaivātṛkamāna nāntam|| 19||
varṇaḥ śulko munibhistri bhuvana sahitasya mantrarājasya| āgama pāragamatirgāndhāro'sya svaro gaditaḥ|| 20||
vidyāmūlotpattireṣā mayoktā jñātavyeyaṃ sarvathā siddhikāmaiḥ| devyā śaptā yena vidyeyamādyā pūrvaṃ tena prāṇahīnā'bhavat sā || 21||
pṛ0 13) śivaśakti vījamata eva śambhunā nihitaṃ tayorupari pūrvavījayoḥ| akulaṃ kulopari ca madhyamādhare dahanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti sorjitā'bhavat|| 22||
bhairavīya muditā kulapūrvā deśikairyadi bhavet kulapūrvā| saiva śīghra phaladā bhuvi vidyetyucyate paśu janeṣvatigopyā|| 23||
śivāṣṭamaṃ kevalamādivījaṃ bhagasya pūrvāṣṭama vījamanyat| paraṃ śiro'ntaṃ gaditā trivarṇā saṅketa vidyā guruvaktagamyā|| 24||
kāntānta vāntā kulavāma netrānvitaṃ tathā dantikulaṃ sanādam| ṣaṭ kūṭa metatripurārṇa vokta matyanta guhyaṃ smara eva sākṣāt|| 25||
kāmarājākhya vījaṃ gaditaṃ uktam | ayaṃ mantro japādeva jagat kṣobhakṛt bhavati| tṛtīyaṃ vīja muddharati| dantānteti dantānāmantya paṅktau nyasyata iti dantānta aukāraḥ tena yutaṃ kulaṃ sakāramuddhareta| kīdṛśaṃ sadanti sānusvāraṃ sakalaṃ visargasahitam asya bījatrayajapādaṇimādi siddhirbhavati khecarī siddhiśca bhavati | aṇimā laghimā garimā prākāmyaṃ vaśiteśitā | prāptiḥ kāmāvasāyitvaṃ śambhoraiśvaryya maṣṭadhā| etadvījatrayātmakaḥ tripurāmantraḥ ṛṣyādiḥ ślokaḥ sugamaḥ|| 17|| 18|| asya mantrasya vījaśaktī āha amuṣyeti | rada okārastasyānta aukāraḥ nakulīśo hakāraḥ tat pūrvaṃ sakāraḥ dantovinduḥ etena sauṃ iti vījaṃ vidyādityadhyā hāryyam | śaktistu ākhaṇḍalena karṇapūrveṇa īkāreṇa arddhajaivātṛkeṇa arddhacandreṇa ca sahitam ānanāntaṃ kakāraṃ jānīyāt | tathācāsya mantrasya sauṃ vījaṃ lkīṃ śaktiḥ śulko varṇaḥ gāndhāraḥ svara iti || 19|| 20|| vidyeti | vidyāyā mūlotpattireṣā mayoktā iyamutpattirvidyāsiddhilipsu bhirjaptavyā| devyeti iyaṃ vidyā devyā śaptā tena prāṇa śūnyā'bhavat|| 21|| śiveti | yata iyaṃ vidyā bhavānyā śaptā ateva hetoḥ tayorādyavījayorupari śivaśakti vījaṃ hasa iti vījaṃ nihitam| uktaṃ hi saṅkīcaḥ paramā śaktiḥ vikāśaḥ parama śivaḥ| śaṅkīcaśca vikāśaśca hasamityakṣaradvayamiti|| parasyāntavījasyīpari akulaṃ hakārī nihitaḥ| madhyavījasyādhare akulaṃ hakārī nihitaḥ| madhya vījasyādhare'dhaḥ repho nihitaḥ| tadavadi svā vidyā tejovatī jātā|| 22|| bhairavīyamiti| iyaṃ bālā vidyā akulapūrvā hakārapūrvā satī bhairavī uktā saiva bhairavī yadi kulapūrvā sakārapūrvā bhavati tadā vidyetyucyate | paśujaneṣu alpajñeṣu aprakāśyā yadvā paśujaneṣu adīkṣiteṣu | tathā etanmantrasya bhedatrayaṃ bhavati vāgbhavādyam| bālā akulapūrvā satī bhairavī kulapūrvā satī vidyeti|| 23|| bīja trayopalakṣitaṃ svatantrañcāha śivāṣṭamamiti| śiva ukārastasyāṣṭama aikāraḥ bhaga ekāraḥ tat pūrvāṣṭamaṃ īkāraḥ paraṃ tṛtīyam| śirīvinduḥ tadantī yasya sa aukāraḥ sa tṛtīya vījopalakṣakaḥ iyaṃ trākṣarī| saṅketavidyā kathitā gurupadeśaiḥ paraṃ budhyate|| 24|| vījāntaramāha kāntānteti| kaṃ vindustasyāntī visarjanīyaḥ tadantaḥ kaḥ vāntaḥ vakāro'nto yasya sa lakāraḥ akulo hakāraḥ sakāro'ntī yasya sa rephaḥ vāmanetram īkāraḥ dantīvinduḥ kulaṃ sakāraḥ sānusvāraṃ sanādam etatripurātantroktaṃ ṣaṭ kuṭaṃ ṣaḍa़्bhirvarṇairbījam atiśayena goptavyam ayaṃ mantraḥ sātrāt smara eva|| 25||
pṛ0 14) ādyaṃ bījaṃ madhyame madhyamādāvantyaṃ cānte yojayitvā japedyaḥ| trailokyāntaḥ pātino bhūtasaṅdhā vaśyāstasyaiśvaryya bhājo bhaveyuḥ|| 26||
ādyaṃ kṛtvā cāvasāne'ntyabījam madhye madhyaṃ cādime sādhakendraḥ| kuryyānnityaṃ yo japenmantramenam jīvanmuktaḥ so'śvate divyasiddhim|| 27||
mantrarājamamuṃ samastajagadvimohanakārakam mātṛkāntaritaṃ japedanulomato'pi vilomataḥ| haṃsadevasamanvitaṃ sakalaṃ badhaḥ para eva vā so'pi divyaguṇānvito labhate sumiddhimanuttamām|| 28||
vyañjana haṃsa samanvitametadrañjana hṛjjagato nikhilasya| yo japati sthiranirmalacittaḥ śīghra mupaiti naraḥ sa tu siddhim|| 29||
kamalaṃ pariluptamadhyamāntya svaramīśādiyutaṃ savindunādam| nigamādinamo'ntare virājadbhavi devo hṛdayaṃ praviṣṭametat|| 30||
vidyā kāmadudhā trilokavinutā svargāpavargapradā guhyād guhyatarā mahodara karī yā yoginīnāmiga | sā sārasvata janmabhūrnigaditā saubhāgyasamyatkarī sadyaḥ pratyayakāriṇī sakṛdapi proccāritā bhūtale|| 31||
yataḥ svapnāvasthāmiyamupagatā viśvavinutā tataḥ siddhiṃ naiva pravitarati japtāpi satatam | prabuddhā cedvidyā phalati sahasā dīpanakarīm tato vidyāṃ vakṣyāmyahamiha rahasyāmatitarām|| 32||
atha kāmanābhedena japtavya mantra bhedānāha ādyamiti| ādimaṃ bījaṃ madhyabīja sthāne madhyabījañjādi bīja sthāne antyaṃ svasthāne evaṃ yojayitvā ya enaṃ mantraṃ japet| vasya trailokyavartinaḥ prāṇinaḥ vaśyā bhavanti aiśvaryyañca bhavati ityekaḥ prakāraḥ|| 26||
aparamāha ādyamiti | ādyaṃ bījaṃ antye antimañca madhye madhyañcādye kṛtvā pratyahaṃ ya enaṃ mantraṃ japati sa jīvanneva mukto bhavati divyānāñca yā siddhistāṃ labhate|| 27||
mantrarājamiti| ya enaṃ santra śreṣṭham anukrameṇa vyut krameṇa ca mātṛkāntastiṃ kṛtvā japati sa divyaguṇabhāk sa tu atulāṃ siddhimāprīti| tatra kramaḥ mantramuccārtha ante akāramuccaret punarapi mantramu्ccārya ākāramuccaret evaṃ lakāraparyyantamakṣarāṇi| mantrāntaritaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā punarmantrarahitaṃ kevalaṃ kṣakārameva sthānīyamuccāryya punaḥ pratiloma krameṇa lakārādiṃ akāraparyyantaṃ pratyekaṃ mantrāntaritaṃ japet | evaṃ mātṛkākṣaramālayā japaṃ kurvatāmekavāreṇa japaḥ śatasaṃkhyāparimitī bhavatītyarthaḥ | śāradā tilake rāghava bhaṭṭena evaṃ vyākhyātam| akārādihakārāntāṃ mātṛtāṃ paṭhitvā madhye mantraṃ paṭhet | oṃ namaḥ carṇo'yaṃ tataḥ kṣakārāghakāntāṃ mātṛkāṃ paṭhet| tato'tulāṃ siddhiṃ labhate| etattu prakārāntaram | haṃsa devamityādi mūlamantra vījatrayaṃ yakārasakārābhyāṃ saṃyojya japet| para eveti | śrīmūlavidyāyāḥ prathama madhyame vīje kevale uccāryya antimaṃ bījaṃ haṃkārasa kārābhyāṃ saṃyojya japedityarthaḥ || 28||
vyañjanahaṃseti| hakārasakārayorantargatākārānusvārāntima visarjanīyamapi lopayitvā kevalavyañjanamāśrameva vidyayā saṃyojya japet so'pyanuttamāṃ siddhiṃ prāpnīti taduktaṃ pratyakṣarārṇaṃ haṃsena grathayitvā japet sudhīriti|| 29||
kamalamiti| kamalasvarupamevoddharet kīdṛśaṃ parilupto madhyo'ntyasvaraśva yatra tādṛśaṃ makārāntya svaraśūnyaṃ lka evaṃrupaḥ| īśaḥ śiva ukārastasyādirīkāraḥ savindunādaṃ tadyuktaṃ tena kakāralakārekāravindunādaiḥ lkīmiti kāmākhyavījam| nigamādiḥ praṇavaḥ nama iti svarupagrahaṇaṃ praṇavanamasīrmadhye kāmavīje nihite caturakṣarātmikā devo hṛdayākhyā vidyā syāt| prāsaṅgikamuktā bhairavīṃ stauti|| 30|| vidyeti| sā vidyā iha bhūtale ca yā vidyā yoginīnāṃ mahodayakarī tatvajñānajanikā kāmadughā īpsitārthapradāyinī atigīpyā | vāraikamapi japtvā satī pratyayadāyinīti|| 31||
yata iti | yatī hetoḥ saptāvasthāṃ gatāṃ iyaṃ vidyā ato vāraṃvāramapi japtvā siddhiṃ
pṛ0 16) puṣpaṃ vārimucāṃ davādiraparastāveva varṇau tato dīrghaṃ vārisakhāntamap svapi tathā dhāntau salokasvarau| vidyā vāg bhava bīja dīpanakārī sārasvatotpattaye sākṣātkāṅghita pārijātalatikā vasvakṣaroktā mayā|| 33||
brahmā śakradṛganvitaḥ sahabhagā meṣānvitā nādinī kāntāntaṃ sabhagaṃ sapūṣaṇamatodhāntaṃ tvimeṣaḥ sadṛk | kālo'nantayutaṃ viyat sadaśanaḥ saṃvartta ko bhīṣaṇā sākrūrā kamalāsanaḥ sahaśivo vaiśvānarastādṛśaḥ || 34||
pṛ0 17) etādaśākṣarīyaṃ manmathabīja prabodhanakarī syāt| kṣobhayati nākabhūtalasthāna vāsinaḥ sahasā|| 35||
sāvitrī vadanayutā mahādikālī vyomāntaṃ śaśadharakhaṇḍamaṇḍitāntam| mohinyā sarasijabhūryu tasyathāgni rvidyeyaṃ parabījadīpanī sā|| 36||
yā yasya dīpanakarī gaditeha vidyā vījasya tasya pura eva samuccarettām| vidyāṣaḍa़ṅgavadaneṣu yathāvadeva nyāseṣu sādhakavaro vidadhīta śañca|| 37||
vidyāṅgamevaṃ nyasataḥ svadehe trailokyamatadvaśameti puṃ saḥ| pāpāni sadyaḥ praśamaṃ prayānti trasyanti rakṣāṃsi sapannagāni|| 38||
mantrarupamidamīritaṃ mayā sarvathā gurumukhena labhyate| gurvanugrahamṛte mahītale mantra eṣa na hi siddhidāyakaḥ|| 39||
iti śrīnāgabhaṭṭaviracite tripurāsārasamuccaye dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ|
na dadāti prabuddhā yadi bhavati tadā haṭhāt phalaṃ dadāti ato hetordīpanīṃ vidyāmasyā ahaṃ kathayāmi rahasyāṃ gopyām| gopanīye rahaḥ smṛtam|| 32||
tratrādyabījadīpanamāha puṣpamiti | meghānāṃ pupṣaṃ jalaṃ tadvījaṃ vakāraḥ tamuccaret | aparo ravarṇaḥ davādirdavaśabdhasyādibhūtodakāraḥ punastāveṣa varṇau rakāradākārauṃ tadanantaraṃ dīrgham ākārasahitaṃ vāri jalavījaṃ sakhā tasthāntena gakāreṇa varttata iti khāntaḥ śakārastamuddharet| apsu vakāraḥ tathā dīrghastena na vāgvā iti bhavati lokasvarayutau dhāntau dho'nte yasya sa dakāraḥ dhasyānto lakāraḥ dakāralakarau loka śabdena trisaṃkhyopalakṣitaḥ tat saṃkhyaka ikāraḥ tena yutau etāvatā vada vada vāgvādini iti bhavati | iyamaṣṭākṣarī vidyā vāgbhavopalakṣitavīja sandīpana janikā sārasvatadharmotpattaye ākāṅdhitārthe kalpalateva|| 33||
dvitīya bījadīpanamantramāha brahmeti| brahmā kakāraḥ śakreṇa dṛśā ca yuktaḥ śakraḥ indraḥ tadvījaṃ lakāḥ dṛśi cakṣuṣi nyasyata iti dṛk ikāraḥ prathamopānvatvāt hasvaparigrahaḥ| nādinī lakāraḥ bhagena ekāreṇa meṣeṇa lakāreṇa cānvitā uddharttavyā kasyāntaḥ khaḥ so'nte yasya sakaḥ sabhagam ekārasahitaṃ sapūṣaṇaṃ salakāram anantaraṃ dhāntaṃ dakāram uddhareta| isvarupo meṣo lakāraḥ sadṛk ikārasahitaḥ | kālī makāraṃ samuddharet| anantena ākāreṇa yutaṃ viyat hakāramuddharet| sadaśanaḥ okāra sahitaḥ saṃvarttakaḥ kṣakāraḥ uddharttavyaḥ | bhīṣaṇaḥ bhakāraḥ sākrūrā sānusvārā kamalāsanaḥ kakāraḥ ukārasahitaḥ vaiśvānarī rephaḥ tādṛśa ukārasahita uddhartavyaḥ etāvatā lkinne lkedini mahākṣobhaṃ kuru iti bhavati|| 34||
iyam ekādaśa varṇā्tamikā vidyā matmathavījasya madhyavījasya dīpikā bhavet|| 35|| tṛtīya vīja dīpanamāha sāvitriti| sāvitrī padena oṅgāro lakṣitaḥ mahādikālī mahākālītyarthaḥ | tadādyavarṇo makāro lakṣitaḥ vadana śrīkārastena yutaḥ vyoma hakāraḥ tadantaṃ sānusvāran uddharet mohinyā ukāreṇa sarasijabhūrbra * kakāra uddharttavyaḥ| tato mohinī ato'griḥ rephaḥ etāvatā oṃ mahāmokṣaṃ kuru iti saptākṣarī caramavījadīpani uktā|| 36||
kena prakāreṇa dīpanayoga ityāha yā yasveti | yā vidyā yasya vījasya dīpanakarī uktā tadvījasya purataḥ prathamaṃ tāṃ vidyāmuccaret|| 37|| nyāseṣu dīpanīyogamāha vidyeti| vidyānyāsaṣaḍa़ṅga nyāsa vadana nyāseṣu yojanīyeti| evaṃ kṛte vidyā prabuddhā bhavati| evaṃ prakāreṇa mūlavidyā mantramyāṅga svaśarīre nyasataḥ puṃ saḥ lokatrayaṃ vaśametri pāpāni śāmyanti sadyaḥ saha|| 38||
pṛ0 18) tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ|
athedaṃ śarīraṃ svakīyāṅgulībhirbudhaiḥ ṣaṇavatyaṅgulāyāma muktam| dineśāṅgulībhiḥ śarīrāt samīro'dhikaḥ prāṇasaṃjño mato yogaviddhiḥ|| 1||
iha prāṇavāyuṃ sadābhyāsato yo naro nyūnabhāvaṃ nayatye namaṅgāt| samatvaṃ śarīreṇa vā bhūtale'smin sa pūjyo budhairuttamo yogavitsa || 2||
caturdaśātrāpaghane pradhānā nāḍyaḥ smṛtāstāsvapi tisra eva| iḍa़ā suṣumnāpi ca piṅgalākhyā mukhyā suṣumnaiva ca tāsu nāḍa़ī|| 3||
pṛ0 19) iḍa़ā nāma nāḍa़ī sthitā vāmabhāge tanordaśiṇe piṅgalā nāma nāḍa़ī| tayoḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ samāśritya madhye suṣumnā sthitā brahmarandhantu yāñca|| 4||
suṣumnāntarāle sthitā citranāḍa़ī yutā pañcavarṇojjavalā pañcadevaiḥ| tadantargataṃ brahmarandhraṃ susūkṣmama mṛṇālāntarālollasattantutulyam|| 5||
idaṃ māyāmantrasvarupaṃ kathitaṃ guruṇā vā yadi labhyate tadā paraṃ sidhyati anyathā guruprasādamantareṇa eṣa mantro na sidhyatoti || 39||
iti tripurāsārasamuccayaṭīkāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ|

evaṃ sādhakānāṃ sakalapuruṣārtha sārabhūtaṃ mantra svarupa muktā puruṣārthāntarāya parihārāya yomāṅga bhūta prāṇāyāma prakārān tadviśeṣāṃśca vaktu mupa kramate athedaṃ śarīramityādinā| idaṃ śarīraṃ paṇḍitaiḥ ṣaḍadhikanavatyaṅguladairghyam uktaṃ yasya śarīrasya parimāṇaṃ tasyaivāṅgulimānena | prāṇasaṃjñakovāyuḥ śarīrānnirgamasthānādadvādaśāṅgulībhiradhiko mataḥ dvādaśāṅguḥ laparyyantaṃ sañcarati|| 1||
iheti | iha bhuviyo naraḥ sadābhyāsataḥ sadābhyāsena enaṃ prāṇavāyuṃ śarīrānnyū na bhāvaṃ sakalāṅga vyāpakatvaṃ nayati| śarīreṇa samāṅgatvaṃ taulyaṃ vā āsanāṅga vyāpakatvaṃ vā karīti sa yogavatāṃ madhye'smin bhūtaleṃ pūjyate iti|| 2||
prāṇāśrayabhūtā nāḍa़ī rdarśayati caturdaśeti | taduktaṃ nāḍa़īnāmāśrayaḥ piṇḍī nāḍyaḥ prāṇasya āśraya iti| asmin śarīre caturdaśa nāḍyaḥ pradhānībhūtāḥ santi api caturdaśasu madhye catasraḥ pradhānāḥ smṛtāḥ|| 3||
tāsāṃ tisṛṇāṃ nāmāni kathayati| iḍe़ti| iḍa़ā piṅgalā suṣumnā ceti tāsvapi tisṛṣu madhye suṣumnaiva pradhānībhūtā | caturdaśanāḍa़īnāṃ nāmāni yathā| iḍa़āca piṅgalā caiva suṣunnā ca sarasvatī | gāndhārī hastijihlā ca supūṣā ca yaśasvinī|| alambuṣā kuhūścaiva śaṅkhinī citriṇī tathā| viśvīdarī viśvamukhī vyāptā hyetā caturdaśa|| etāsvapi tisrī mukhyāḥ yāsvapi yogaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ tāsvapi suṣumnaiva mukhyā sā ca dvādaśāntaṃ pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ samāśritya sakalādhāratvenādhomukhī ṛjubhūtātiṣṭhati| ādhārī nāma padma sthānāt dvyaṅgu lādūrddhaṃ neḍhrādradvyaṅgu lādadhobhāge caturaṅgu lāyāmavistāraṃ aṅgu lonnataṃ tvāgādidhātubhirveṣṭitaṃ caturdalātmakaṃ pāṇḍarākāraṃ padmaṃ tat karṇikāmadhye trikoṇā yoniḥ tanmadhye sakala prapañcanimittopādānabhūtā kuṇḍalyākhyā cinmayī śaktiḥ triguṇitādirupeṇa sūryyendu vaiśvānarāṇāṃ mūlabhūtā bhramati yā trikoṇamutthitā suṣumnā nāma nāḍa़ī vīṇādaṇḍākhyapṛṣṭhavaṃśasya purībhāga bhavalambā brahmarandha paryyantam ūrddhākāra tiṣṭhati| tathāca tantracūḍa़āmaṇiḥ| merudaṇḍe vahiḥ pārśve candrasūryyātimastake | kimbā madhye - suṣumnā sanniviṣṭā ca tranmadhye citra rupiṇī| tatraiva grathitaṃ padmaṃ mūlādipadma pañcakam | kalikā kārarupeṇa ḍākinyā dyāvalambitam | mūladvāraṃ samācchādya sthitā māgasvarupiṇī| vāyunā bhidyane muktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ citrā nayettataḥ| tacchasojjavalakāmasya śikhayā'ti samujjavalā| praticakra prabuddhā sā jīvātmānaṃ pare kule| niyojayati tadvayogādamṛtaṃ carate ciram | vyoma prīdbhidya nāsāgre gatau candradivākārau| adhodhakraṃ mahāpadmaṃ kroḍa़īkṛtya suṣumnayā| vyāghuyya nāsikā madhyaṃ gataṃ citrā tu taṭgatā | ūrddhaṃ bhitvā tu liṅgaṃ
pṛ0 20) brahmasūtramidameva dehināṃ jovabhūta mamṛtai kekāraṇam | yadvadanti munayaḥ purātanā divyamārga iti bhavyacetasaḥ|| 6||
pṛ0 21) iḍa़āyāṃ caratyeṣa śītāṃśumālī ato vāmabhāge'mṛtaṃ sampradiṣṭam| raviḥpiṅgalāyāṃ caratyeṣa tasmād viṣaṃ dakṣiṇo bhāga ukto munīndraiḥ|| 7||
jānīyādudayaṃ ba़dhaḥ svajaṭhare kande'śarīraṃ nṛṇām ghrāṇāttigmakarāṅgule khalu layaṃ sandhaye ca pūrvāpare| utpattiñca layañca santatamadhovṛtti niśāṃ vāsaram corddhāṃ vṛttimadhastathā himakaraṃ corddhāṃ dineśaṃ gatim || 8||
tuṣārāṃśunāḍa़īṃ prapanne tu deve tadā śāntikādīni karmāṇi kuryyāta| budho raudrakarmāmi mārttaṇḍanāḍa़ī mubhe miśrakarmāṇi nāḍyau prapanne|| 9||
vai itarān puṣkarān tataḥ| vahīruddhamanākāṅghākāṅghiṇī mokṣadāyinī| jīvanādṛṣṭasambaddhā sthirā paramasannidhau| etadvedaṃ vijānāti bhitvā yāti para padam| ityādi ghahuśaḥ| yogārṇave'pi | suraśṛṅgārṭapārśvena tenaiva savyataḥ kramāt sūryyā candramasau nāḍyau gate nāsādvayāvavi| tanmadhye dvitīyaṃ bhitvā suṣumnā padmekīṭare | brahmarandhoṃvadhiryātā bhitvā vyīma bhūrālayam| sukhenācchādya tadvāra kuṇḍalauśaktirujjvalā| niṃdrāvaśagatā devī prasuptabhujagopamā| tantriṃkoṇasya vāmadakṣiṇakoṇayoḥ sambhū te suṣumnāyāṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhāge iḍā़piṅgale sthire| tayormadhye iḍa़ā nāma nāḍī copā kṛtirbhūtvā liṃṅgamūlasthāne suṣumnāmāśliṣya dakṣiṇabhāgaṃ gatā tadākārā punarapi nābhi sthāne vāmabhāgaṃ gatā| tadā punarapi hṛdaya sthānamāśliṣya dakṣiṇabhāgaṃ gatāṃ| tadā karauṃ punarapi jānumūlamāśliṣya vāmanāsāpuṭaṃ gaṃcchati| evaṃ dakṣiṇa bhāgasambhūtā piṅgalā muṣumnāmāśliṣya dakṣiṇanāsāvivaraṃ gacchati| suṣumnāmūlapurobhāgādutthitā ājihāntaṃ sarasvatau nāma nāḍa़ī sthita* kecittu trayaṃ varṇatrati| etāḥ suṣumnāstisraśca yāsuṃ yogaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ | tāścaṃ nāsāpuṭadvandvaṃ brahmarandha vinirgatāḥ| sarasvatyādi catvāro mukharandhra vinirgatāḥ| tāsvekā śabdajananī anyā svarasavāhinī| aparā rasanādhārā parā tīryavahā śivā | anyāḥ ṣaṭ netra karmāṅgamedodvāravinirgatāḥ| śaṅginī nābhisambandhā yā nātu rhadi rudhyate| yayā garbhagataḥ piṇḍaḥ puṣyate'nna rasādibhiḥ | etābhya eva nāḍībhyaḥ śākhopaśākha prakāreṇa sārddha lakṣatraya saṃkhyānāṃ nāḍa़īnāṃ sambhavaḥ| kunnaṃ kā nāḍa़ī tiṣṭhati iti śiṣyākāṅgā yāmāha iḍa़eti śarīrasya vāmāṃśamāśrityaṃ iḍa़ā nāma nāḍa़ī dakṣiṇabhāgaṃ piṅgalā tayornāḍyormadhye dehasya pṛṣṭhavaṃśamāśritya brahmarandhra paryyantaṃ suṣumnā avasthiteti| muṣumnāyā abhyantare citrā nāḍa़ī sthitā pañcabhirvarṇaiḥ śvetaraktādibhirujjavalā pañcabhirdevairbrahmaviṣṇu rudre śvarasadāśivaiḥ saṃyuktā| taduktam| brahmā janādaṃnī rudra īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ| citrākhyanādyantaḥ sthāśca pañcabhūtādhidevatāḥ|| 4| 5||
brahmeti| idameva brahmasūtraṃ śarīriṇāṃ prāṇamṛtāṃ jīvabhūtam amṛtaikakāraṇam asminneva jñāyate maraṇaṃ na caratītyarthaḥ | yad brahmasūtraṃ prācīnā munayo divyamārga iti kathayanti nirvāṇopayogī sa eva mārga ityarthaḥ|| 6||
iḍa़āyāmiti | eṣa śiśirakiraṇī vāṃme iḍa़āsaṃjñāyāṃ nāḍyāṃ caratri cena vāmabhāge'mṛtramuktaṃ piṅgalā vāmādibhyaśvarati sā ca dakṣiṇabhāgamāśriteti sa bhāgo viṣasaṃjñakaḥ ādityasya khecaratvāt vāyuniyamena sivyatīti|| 7|| tasyotpatti vināśajñānamāha jānīyāditi | budhaḥ aśarīre vāyornṛṇāṃ kande mūlabhūte ādhāre cakre udayam udbhavaṃ jānīyāt | tathā ādhāracakre gudopari liṅgādhaḥ sthite vāyuruntiṣṭhati ghrāṇādvahirdvādaśāṅgule vinaśyatītyarthaḥ| tadeva sthāna dvayaṃ pūrvāpare sandhye kandāt pūrvasaṃkhyā ghrāṇe dvādaśāṅgulaṃ vahiryāti| paścādetauti sthāna dvayam utpattiṃ layaṃ vināśaṃ ca te eva jñātavye| ādhāreti| vāyoradhogamanaṃ niśāṃ jānīāyāt ūrddhagamanaṃ vāsaraṃ divasaṃ jānīyāt| uktaṃ hi ahareva prāṇoṃ rātrirapāna iti tathādhovṛttiṃ candraṃ jānīyāt ūrddhaṃ gamanamiti| ateva yogārṇave varṣetyadhomukhaścandraḥ śeṣetṣū ddhaṃmukhoraviriti|| 8||
kena vāyau kāni karmāṇi karttavyānītyāha tuṣārāṃśunāḍa़īmiti tuṣārāṃśunāḍa़ī iḍa़āṃ nate vāyau śāntijanakāni karmāṇi kuryyāt | sūryyanāḍa़īṃ piṅgalāṃ gatre rātrau raudrāṇi dāruṇāni karmāṇi kuryyāt | candramasaḥ śītalāśu
pṛ0 22) bhūtānāmudayaṃ dvayorapi budhaḥ saṃlakṣayet pakṣayostannādho vasudhodayaṃ niśitadhīrghrāṇasya daṇḍasmṛśi| deve'dhaḥ spṛśi vāriṇo hutavahasyorddhaṃ gate tūkṣyam tiryyaksaṃspṛśi mārutasya paritaḥ spṛṣṭe marudvartmanaḥ|| 10||
vaśyastambhanayoḥ praśasta udayo bhūśerjalasyodayaḥ śastaḥ śāntikapīṣṭikādiṣu śubheṣvanhāya vadneḥ punaḥ| śatrormāraṇadāraṇādikaraṇeṣūccāṭanocchāsayo rvāyoḥ śāntikanirviṣīkaraṇayorvyomno hitaścodayaḥ|| 11||
dharaṇerudaye gadārditānām yadi dūtaḥ samupetya pṛcchatīha sahasā nahi rogajā prabādhā praśamaṃ yāti cikitsitāpi samyak|| 12||
pṛ0 23) jalodaye vyādhirupaiti śāntiṃ mṛtyurbhavatyeva vasūdaye ca| tathodaye cāpi samīraṇasya vyomno'cireṇaiva rujāṃ vināśaḥ|| 13||
deve dakṣiṇa bhāgage'tha puruṣo rogāturo dakṣiṇe sthitvā pṛcchati pṛcchakaḥ sa puruṣo jīvatyarogaściram | vāmāyāṃ tu rujākulokṛtatanī vāmāśrite ceśvare vāmā pṛcchati cet sthitā gatagadā vāmāciraṃ jīvati|| 14||
deve gate pṛcchati vāmabhāgaṃ sthitvā naro dakṣiṇato yadīha| vyatyāsato'smādapi kṛcchasādhyaṃ vadanti santaḥ khalu rogajātam|| 15||
antargate pṛcchati pṛcchakaśveddeve naro jīvati vītarogaḥ| tenaiva rogeṇa vahirgate'smin paretarājasya puraṃ prayāti|| 16||
sarveṣu kāryyeṣu yadīśvare'smin antargate vāñchitasiddhayaḥ syuḥ| vahirgate'maṅgalasīśvare'pi śubhāśubhaṃ karmaphalaṃ tu vidyāt|| 17||
tvāt myyaṃsya kharakaratvāditi bhāvaḥ| ubhayana| ḍa़īsthe vāyau śāntikāni raudrāṇi ca kamāṇi kuryyāta|| 9|| bhatānāmiti| dvayorapi pakṣayoḥ śulka kṛṇayorbhūtānāṃ pṛthivyapte tejovāyvā kāśānām udadhavaṃ salakṣayet avadhārayet| tava bhateṣu madhye pṛthivyā udayaṃ ghrāṇa madhyadaṇḍaga* vāyau yadā praśasyate daṇḍākāragatirbhavati tadā bhūmerudayaṃ jānīyāt| deve vāyau adhaḥ spṛśi sati vāriṇo jalasya udayaṃ jānīyāt| ūrddhaṃ gate vāyau hata vahasyāgrerudayaṃ jānīyāt| tiryyak pārśvaddayaṃ saṃspṛśi vāyorudayaṃ jānīyāt| samastanāsārandhre vyāpake vāyau vahati sati maruhartmana ākāśasya udayaṃ jānīyāt|| 10|| etaj jñāna phalamāha vaśyeti | bhumerudaye vaśyajanakaṃ stambhajanakañca karma kuryyāta| jalabhratasyodaye sati śāntijanakaṃ puṣṭijanakañca karma kuryyāt| bhaṭiti sa tu māraṇādi janake karmaṇi vaddherudayaḥ praśastaḥ| śacordaśonmūlane nagarocchede ca vāyorudayaḥ praśastaḥ| nirviṣīkaraṇasāntvane ca ākāśasyodayaḥ praśastaḥ|| 11|| praśnamāha dharaṇeriti| pṛthivyā udaye sati nairujyamamukasya bhaviṣyati dūta āgatya pṛcchani tadā rogajā pīḍa़ā sadyaḥ kṛtapratikriyāpi haṭhena śāntiṃ nayatoti vaktavyamityarthaḥ| jalasyodaye sati yadi pṛcchati tadā vyādhiḥ śāntiṃ yāti| vasūdaye'grerudaye yadi pṛcchati tadā rogārttasya mṛtyurbhavati| vasuhutāśanamiti viśvaḥ| vāyorudaye yadi pṛcchati tadā mṛtyurityarthaḥ| ākāśodaye yadi āgavya pṛcchati tadā tvarayaiva rogāṇāṃ vināśo bhavati|| 12| 13| 14||
prakārāntamāha| deve vāyau dakṣiṇāṃ saṅgate sati sadaiva sthitvā dūto yadi pṛcchati tadā rogārtto jano nīrogaḥ san bahuśatatryaṃ jīvati| striyāṃ rogagavāāyāṃ vāmabhāgagatī vāyurbhavati tatrāścitī dūtaḥ pṛcchati tadānīṃ rogāt sā ciraṃ jīvati iti|| 15||
deva iti | vāmapradeśaṃ gate vāyau dakṣiṇāṃśaṃ gatvā dūto yadi pṛcchati tadā kaṣṭa sādhyaṃ mairujyaṃ vaktavyam| dakṣiṇage vāyau vāmabhāgagaḥ pṛcchati tadā kaṣṭasādhyaṃ nairujyaṃ vadet| antargata iti| abhyantaraṃ gate vāyau yadi pṛcchakaḥ pṛcchati tadā nīrogī jīvati | ghrāṇādvahirddhādaśāṅgu * lāihirgate vāyau yadi pṛcchati tadā tenaiva rogeṇa yamālayaṃ
pṛ0 24) ārambha darśa prathamāmudeti vāme puṭe trīṇi dināni devaḥ| vāmetare trīṇi tato dināni pūrṇā tithi rvāvadathaivameva|| 18||
athārabhya śulkānya pakṣādibhūtām tithi trīṇi devo dinānyabhyudeti| puṭe dakṣiṇe triṇi vāme tu yāvat kuhurevamevaṃ samālakṣayennā|| 19||
ekasya pakṣasya piparyyayeṇa rogābhibhūtirbhavatīha puṃsām| tayordvayorbandhusuhṛdvipattiḥpakṣatraye vyavyayato mṛtriḥ syāt|| 20||
pṛ0 25) yadātmanaḥ kālavaśāt samīraṇo viparyyudeti prakṛtiṃ vihāya saḥ| tadā nirudhya śvasanaṃ nipīḍa़yed yathā sthitaṃ pakṣamupaiti cātmanaḥ|| 21||
dvāveva dhattaḥ sakalañca kālaṃ divākaraḥ kairavabāndhavaśca| bhoktī suṣumnā sakalasya cāsya kālasya doṣādivasātmakasya|| 22||
tataḥ krameṇaiva viśuddhanāḍa़īpathāntaraḥ prāṇasamīraṇasya| śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṃyamane prayatnaṃ yathāvidhānaṃ vidadhīta dhīraḥ|| 23||
śī tāṃśumārgeṇa śanaiḥ samīramāpūrayet svodaramādareṇa| vikāramātrabhirapetatandraḥ kālāgnimūlarpitacittavṛttiḥ|| 24||
tato dhārayenmārutaṃ śuddhacetāścatuḥ ṣaṣṭimātrāḥ samāpūritaṃ tam | vahirbhāsvatā recayenmandamenaṃ tadarddhābhirantarniruddhaṃ tu tābhiḥ|| 25||
rogī yātīti | kāryyāntare tat prayojanaṃ kathayati| yadīśvare vāyau antargate atra kāryye ākāṅgita siddhirbhavati vahirgate dvādaśāṅgu lādadhikaṃ gate sarvakāryyāṇi naśyantīti| kati dināni kutra tiṣṭhatīti kathayati|| 16| 17|| ārabhyeta | darśa eva prathamā tithiryasthāḥ pratipadaḥ sā darśaprathamā pratipat tena śukrapratipadāditithitraye vāme caturthyādi dakṣiṇe saptamyādi vāme daśamyādi dakṣiṇe vayodaśyādi vāme kṛṣṇa pratipadādi dakṣiṇe caturthyādi vāme saptamyādi dakṣiṇe daśamyādi vāme trayodaśayādi dakṣiṇe | athetyanantaraṃ śulkānyapakṣādibhūtāṃ kṛṣṇapratipattithimupakramya trīṇi dināni dakṣiṇabhāge vāyurudetītyādi saṃkhyā uktā evaṃ nā puruṣa udaraṃ lakṣayet|| 18| 19||
ekasyeti| yadye katra pakṣe bāyorvaiparītyaṃ bhavati tadā tasva puruṣasya rogajanito'bhibhavī bhavati| śulkapratipadādidinatrayaṃ yāvadvāyurvāmapuṭe sañcarati tatra yadi dakṣiṇapuṭe bhavati evaṃ pañcadaśadinaparyyantaṃ yadi vyatyayo bhavati tadā rogābhibhūtirbhavati māsamātraṃ vaiparītyena suhṛdāṃ vipattiḥ pañcacatvāriṃśaddināni yāvadvyatyayo tasya puruṣasya maraṇaṃ bhavatīti | vāyorvaiparītye rogādikaṃ bhavatīti svābhāvikī gatiḥ || 20|| viparītodaye śubhodayaḥ kathaṃ syādityāha yadeti| svakīyādṛṣṭavaśādvāyurvaiparītye udeti tadādibodhaṃ kṛtvā śvāsaṃ pīḍa़yet yathā puṭāntaraṃ gacchati|| 21|| dvāveveti| kumudabandhuścandraḥ sūryyaścāsau sakalaṃ kālaṃ dhattaḥ divārātrirasātmakasya rātrindrivīpalakṣitasya kālasya bhīktī bhakṣikā suṣumnā paraṃ nānyā nāḍa़ībhīktṛtvaṃ nāma citkalāsamavetasya tasvopādhitayā rupatvamāpādya sarvasvābhibhākatva mityarthaḥ|| 22||
tata iti| suṣumnaiva bhīktī tadā krameṇa viśīdhitanāḍa़īmārgāntaraḥ san prāṇavāyoḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṃyamane niyame prayatnaṃ yathā kathitaprakāreṇa kurvīta|| 23|| tameva prakāraṃ kathayati śītāṃśumārga iti| śītāṃśoścandrasya vartmanā vāmanāḍyā vāyubhiḥ svakīyamudaraṃ vikāramātrayā ṣīḍa़śamātrayā pūrayet| apetā tandrā nidrā yasya saḥ kālāgrimūlārpitacittavṛttiḥ| kālāgrimūle mūlādhāre'rpitā cittavṛttirvyāpāro yena|| 24|| tata iti| pūritaṃ vāyuṃ catuḥ ṣaṣṭimātrāparyyantaṃ dhārayet tasya gatāgaṃta virodhayet bhāsvatā sūryyamārgeṇa dakṣiṇayā śanaistadarddhābhirdvātriṃ śanmātrābhirabhyantare niruddhaṃ taṃ vāyuṃ retayet tyajet || 25||
pṛ0 26) viparītamato vidadhīta budhaḥ punarapyatha tadviparītamiti| amunā vidhinā sumanāḥ satataṃ maruto vidadhīta susaṃyamanam|| 26||
prasvedaṃ janayati yaḥ prāṇāyāmeṣu so'dhamaḥ proktaḥ| kalpomadhyaḥ puṃsāṃ bhūmityāgaṃ tanostanoti paraḥ|| 27||
tāvadvidadhīta budhaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ samāhito vidhivat | yāvat sambhavati* bhuvi prāṇāyāmasyottamasya guṇaḥ|| 28||
ayaṃ prāṇāyāmaḥ sakaladuritadhvaṃsanakaro vigarbhaḥ prokto'sau śataguṇaphalo garbhakalitaḥ| japa dhyānāpetaḥ sa tu nigadito garbharahitaḥ sa garbhastūnmukto muniparivṛtairyoganirataiḥ|| 29||
śuciḥ prāṇāyāmān praṇavasahitān ṣoḍa़śa vaśīprabhāte sāyañca pratidivasamevaṃ vitanute| dvijo yastaṃ mnūṇapraharaṇakṛtāṃgho'bhikalitam punantye te mājādiha duritatūlaughadahanāḥ|| 30||
trāyantyamī ṣaḍa़bhirapīha māsairjanmāntaropārjitapāpapuñjāt| saṃvatsarādvahmapadaṃ tadekaṃ prakāśayantye va yadacyutākhyam|| 31||
iha recakapūrakau vihāya sthiradhīḥ kumbhakameva kevalaṃ yaḥ| satataṃ kurute manojavatvaṃ labhate vītajarāmayaḥ sa martyaḥ|| 32||
pṛ0 27) na hi tasya sudurlabhaṃ trilokyāmiha yaḥ kevalaṃ kumbhake niṣasyaḥ| aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakaṃ karastham nanu tasyaiva nirastamṛtyu bhīteḥ|| 33||
rājadantayugalādimaspṛśan sannidhāpya rasanāṃ tadantike| kākacañcupuṭamārutaṃ pivet prāṇasaṃyamanametaduttamam|| 34||
dvikacañcusamamīraṇaṃ śanairdhayataḥ samparikṛtya sandhyayoḥ| śramadāhagarodarāmayajvaragulmāḥ praśamaṃ prayānti ca|| 35||
ubhayorapi sandhyayo rmuhūrtte pikadhātu rdhayatastrimāsamātram| sarasaṃ dvikacañcugandhavāhaṃ bhuvi sārasvatasiddhiruttamā syāt|| 36||
viṣamugramudagravīryyabhājāṃ pravināśaṃ samupaiti pannagānām | kimu vṛścikakīṭalūtakānāmiha kākolamukhānilasya pānāt|| 37||
dvikacañcasamīraṇaṃ naraḥ sarasaṃ yaḥ parikṛṣya sandhyayoḥ | kurute nijakuṇḍalīmukhe kṣayarogaṃ sa vimucya jīvati|| 38||
dvikacañcusamīraṇaṃ naro yaḥ pivatīhāniśameva bītatantraḥ|
viparītamiti| athaḥ prakṛtādviparītaṃ vidadhīta kuryyāt | punarapi tadviparītaṃ prakṛtakrameṇādika punarapi tadviparītam evamabhyaset amunā prakāreṇa maruto vāyorniyamaṃ na kuryyāt|| 26|| prasvedamiti | ayaṃ sugamaḥ|| 27|| 28|| ayamiti | garbho garbhaśūnyaḥ prāṇāyāma uktaḥ san sakaladūritāni vināśayati garbheṃṇa sahito'yaṃ śataguṇaphalasahitaḥ kathitaḥ vigarbhāpekṣayo ko vigarbhaḥ kaḥ sagarbhaḥ ityākāṅkṣayāmāha japeti| japairdhyānaiśca śūnyo yaḥ garbharahitaḥ tābhyāṃ yukto yaḥ sagarbhaḥ kathitaḥ|| 29|| śucirityādi| catuṣṭayaṃ sugamam|| 30-33|| rājajanteti| rājadantayugaladvayasvādimaspṛśan teṣām antike samīpe jihvāṃ sannidhāpya kākacañcupuṭena vāyuṃ pivet| kākacañcupuṭavanmukhaṃ kṛtvā pivedityarthaḥ| madhyabhūtadantacatuṣṭayaṃ rājadantāḥ etadutkṛṣṭaṃ vāyorniyamanamiti|| 34|| dviketi| dvikacañcubhyāṃ samīraṇaṃ vāyuṃ dhayataḥ pivataḥ dheṭ pā pāne| dvābhyāṃ kakārābhvāṃ lakṣito dvikaḥ kākaḥ śramadāhaṃ garoviṣam udarāmayam udararogaḥ jvaraḥ ** ityādyāḥ praśūmaṃ prayānti|| 35|| ubhayoriti| ubhayoḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyayo rmuhūrtte daṇḍadvayaṃ yāvat praharatrayamātra vā kaṃ śmaśruṃ tasya dhātuḥ dharttuḥ puṃsaḥ kākacañcu puṭamārutaṃ pivataḥ sārasvata siddhibhaṃvati sandhyāmuhūrttamātraṃ prahuratrayaṃ veti vyavasthitavikalpārthaḥ|| 36||
pṛ0 28) bhavati dhruvameva tasya varṣācchavaṇaṃ darśanamapyatīva dūrāt|| 29||
bahudhā kathitairmuhuḥ kimebhirdvikacañcvā tu samīraṇasya pānāt| jarasā saha nāśamāśu yāti prabalaṃ mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayaṃ narāṇām || 40||
jihvāṃ kṛtvā'nākulastālumūle dantairdantān gāḍha़māpīḍa़yitvā| mandaṃ mandaṃ yaḥ pivedgandhavāhaṃ saudhaiḥ puraiḥ sākamantaḥ spṛśadbhiḥ|| 41||
ṣaṇmāsābhyāsena rogairaśeṣaiḥ pāpebhyo'sau mucyate sādhakendraḥ| abdādekādviśrasāṃ mṛtyudūtīṃ jitvā bhūmau dīrghakālaṃ sa jīvet|| 42||
varṣatrayābhyāsavaśātītamanāgataṃ vettyalinīlakeśaḥ| viṣaṃ na dehe kramate tadīye daṣṭe sughorairapi pannagendraiḥ|| 43||
na kṛtrimaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ vā viṣaṃ kimanyairapi kālakūṭaiḥ| guṇāṣṭakaṃ kālavaśādupetya mahītale krīḍa़ti bhairavo vā || 44||
yā muṇḍādhāradaṇḍāntaravivaragatāhāranīhāragaurī saudhīṃ dhārāṃ nabho'mbhoruhakuharavidhoḥ saṃsravantīṃ vahantī| tasyā vajrākhyanāḍyāḥ khagamudaradarīmadhyagaṃ yo vidadhyāt tasyā brahmāṇḍa bhāṇḍapralayamapavanaṃ syādaghanaṃ mṛtyumṛtyoḥ|| 45||
pṛ0 29) mūrcchāṃ gato harati rogasamūhamadhyāruddhaḥ karoti gagane gamanaṃ narāṇām| vāto mṛto vitanute'maratāṃ samastamabhyāsataḥ sulabhameva samīraṇasya|| 46||
atha pārṣṇiniruddha kamburnā dhvajamūlasthita savyapādapārṣṇiḥ| ṛjukāyaśirodharo yatātmā viṣayebhyo vinivarttitendriyāśvaḥ|| 47||
kakīcañcvagrahṛṣṭairmu hurudaradarīṃ pūrayitvā samīrairastuṣṭābhyāmubhābhyāṃ nararipuvivare tarjanībhyāṃ ca netre| nāsārandhraṃ nirudya sthiravimala matirmadhyamābhyāmathāsyama nyābhi rnātigāḍha़ṃ kamalajanilaye sthāpayenmānasaṃ kham || 48||
viṣamiti| kākīlaḥ trayaṃ sugamam|| 37 - 40||
jihvāmiti | tālupradeśe jihvāṃ yojayitvā uparisthadantapaṅ ktyā'dhodantāvaliṃ āpīḍya saudhaiḥ pūrvamukhāvasthitaiḥ saha gandhavāhaṃ vāyuṃ pivet anyat sugamam | prakārāntaramāha jihvāmiti| saudhairmukhāntargatarasaiḥ visrasrāṃ jarāṃ kṛtimaviṣaṃ nārikelamiśrita karpūraṃ sthāvaraṃ himaśailajādikaṃ jaṅgamaṃ pārvatīyaṃ vyāghranābhijanyaṃ guṇāṣṭakam aṣṭasiddhirbhairavāvatārārthai vāśabdaḥ|| 41 - 44||
yā muṇḍeti| suṣumnāntargatāyā vajrākhyanāḍyā udarameva darī kandarā tanmadhyavarttimaṃ khamaṃ vāyuṃ yo vidhānaṃ karoti tasya pavanaṃ śarīraṃ mṛtyu mṛtyordhanaṃ mudgaraṃ bhavati | mṛtyuryamaḥ tasya mṛtyu rnāśakaḥ tasya lohamudgaro bhavati| ghanaḥ syāsalloha mudgara ityamaraḥ| sā kā muṇḍādhāradaṇḍāntaravivaragarttā muṇḍasyācārabhūto daṇḍaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśātmakaḥ tadantargatasuṣumnā tanmadhyavarttinamityarthaḥ | kīddaśāhave himavacchubhrāmṛtadhārāṃ vahantī dhārayantī ākāśadeśāvasthita padmābhyantaravarnti novidhīścandrasya kṣarantīm tathāca yaḥ suṣumnāntargatavāyuṃ nirīdhayati tasya maraṇaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ|| 45|| mūrcchāmiti| mūrcchā niśceṣṭatve sati iti yāvat| addhā tattvena rogasaddhāṃtaṃ nivārayati| vaddhaḥ san nāḍyantare niruddhaḥ āyattaḥ san manuṣyāṇām ākāśagamanaṃ nirādhārasañcāraṃ karīti mṛtaḥ manasā saha yāti svābhīṣṭadeśaṃ tathā vilīnaḥ amaratām amaramaṃ nayati| tathāca mūrcchito harato vyādhiṃ nihanyānmaraṇaṃ mṛtaḥ| baddhaḥ khecaratāṃ kuryyāt vaśo vāyuśca bhairavi ! || 46|| prakārāntaramāha tatheti| nā puruṣaḥ svīyamānasaṃ kamalajanmanī brahmaṇī nilaye ādhārakamale'vasthāpayet | kīddak pārṣṇinā ekapādagulaphena niruḍyaḥ kambuniru्ddhagudamārgo yena saḥ dhvajamūle liṅgamūle'va sthāpitā aparapādapārṇiyena saḥ| ṛju kāyaḥ avakraśarīraḥ yatātmā indriyameva durddharatvādaśva ivāśvaḥ || 47|| kākīti| kākabadhūmukhenākṛṣṭairvāyubhirudaradarīṃ pūrayitvā karadvayasyāṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ * nararipuvivare vakṣyamāṇaṃ naro arjunaḥ tasya ripuḥ karṇaḥ karṇavivara ityarthaḥ| tarjanī dvayena netradvayaṃ madhyamābhyām aṅgu lībhyāṃ māsāpuṭaṃ nirudhva anyābhiścacurbhirmukhaṃ nirudhya|| 48||
pṛ0 30) yathāśaktyābhyāsaṃ pratidivasa mevaṃ vidadhataḥ suṣumnāntaścāyaṃ pracarati śanai rdehapavanaḥ| tadā nādo naijo bhavati sahasānandajananaḥkramādvīṇā vādiprahata mṛduvīṇīravaśayaḥ|| 49||
ādau mattālimālāgalapathavimalattārabhktaṅkārahārī nādo'sau vaṃśikāṃsyāṃ nilabharitala sadvaṃśanisvānatulyaḥ| ghaṇṭānādānukārī tadanu jalanidhidhvānadhīro gabhīro garjaṃ paryya nyaghoṣaḥ para iha kuhare varttate brahmanāḍyāḥ|| 50||
vijite bhavatīha tena vāyuḥ sahajo yasya samutthita prasādaḥ| aṇimādiguṇā bhavanti tasyāmitapuṇyasya mahāsukhāspadasya|| 51||
surarājatanujaverirandhre vinirudhya svakarāṅgulīdveyena| jaladheriva dhīranādamantaḥ prasavantaṃ sahasā śrṛṇoti martyaḥ|| 52||
paribhāvayato'pi nādamenaṃ tridaśādhīśatanūjavairijātam| satataṃ bhavatīha tasya jantorguṇa sampattirapeta kalmaṣasya|| 53||
śrṛṅgāṇyaṅgulibhirnirudhya vidhivat kodaṇḍayoḥ paṇḍito madhye baddhamarunnirudhya vṛṣabhaśreṣṭhañca ṣaṣṭhendriyam |
pṛ0 31) sākṣāttat kṣaṇameva paśyati śanaistrayyantagītaṃ param jyotistraipuramaṅkamuktaśaśabhṛllakṣābhalakṣaprabham|| 54||
iti śrīnāgabhaṭṭaviracite tripurāsārasamuccaye tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ|
caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ|
atha pūrakayogayojitānataḥ pṛṣadaśvo nijamūlacakradeśe| vidadhīta budhaḥ samāhito'jopapadagranthivibhedane prayatnam|| 1||
śakvat samutsṛjya yathā śanaiḥ svaṃ saṅkocayet kambuni mārgamarvā| budhastathā dhvāraniyojitātmā saṅkocayet kambuni mārgamuccaiḥ|| 2||
yatheti| evamanena kathitaprakāreṇa pratidinamabhyasatraḥ puṃ saḥ suṣusrābhyantare ayaṃ vāyuḥ sañcarati yadi tadā satatānandajanakī brahmapradī nāda utpadyate krameṇa punarvīṇā samaravī bhavati vīṇāvādiprakvatatvenātiśaya madhura dhvaniriti| dvayaṃ sugamam || 49- 51||
sūrarājeli| murarāja indraḥ tattanujo'rjunaḥ tadvairī karṇaḥ tatra svahastadvayāṅga lidvayena nirudhyaḥ samudrasyeva gabhīraṃ śabdamabhyantare prasarantaṃ śṛṇoti martyaḥ tasyāpagatapābhanaḥ guṇāvāptirbhavati mokṣaprāptirbhavatītyarthaḥ|| 52| 53||

ekībhūtārṇavāmbhaḥ plutamakhilajagat pūrvamāsīdapūrvajyotirmūrtista dantarmahitamahima bhūrliṅgarūpī vabhūva| ṣaṭ siddhādhiṣṭhitātmā sakala suranutaḥ ṣaḍ bhirāsyairupetaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ koṣaiśca devo bhavabhayatimiradhvaṃ sahaṃso maheśaḥ|| 9||
ādyaṃ liṅgavapurbhṛto bhagavato devodviraṇḍo'bhavadvālī pūrvamukhaṃ śivasya tu mahākālastadūrddhānanam| vaktaṃ dakṣiṇamāśuśukṣaṇirasau devaḥ pinākī punaḥ ṣāścātyaṃ chagalāṇḍa eṣa bhagavān vāmāsyamasyābhavat|| 10||
śakāraḥ | evamagrestṛtīyaṃ ṣakāraḥ madhyavarṇa uktaḥ | evaṃ vāyoryakārasya caturtho dantyasakāraḥ | tena vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ iti varṇān prathamādyaṃ vījaṃ tato vakāraḥ tava ādyaṃ vījaṃ evaṃ krameṇa caturdaleṣu catvārī varṇā nyastavyā ityarthaḥ| kevalān vā kevalaṃ vinduyuktaṃ nyaset | tatra caturdale ḍākinīrūpā devī etatsakalaprapañcamūlabhūtatvāt mūlādhāramiti yoginī vadanti| asmin mūlādhāre dhyānācaraṇāt puṃsaḥ stambhakṣobhau bhavataḥ | niṣkiyatvaṃ bhavati| ut plutiḥ utpavanaṃ dārdurī dardurī maṇḍūkastatsambandhinī platiriti yāvat | mūmityāgaśca bhavati tadanu khecaratvaṃ bhavati| ākāśe'pi svecchāvirāritvaṃ bhavati krameṇa ete ṣaḍ guṇā bhavanti|| 2 -4||
anyān guṇān darśayati kāntīti | śarīrasya kānterutkarṣo bhavati| nādavyaktiḥ nādī dhvaniviśeṣaḥ| jaṭharānalasya uddīpanaḥ indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāmakapaṭatvaṃ bhavati| yoginī hi indriyāsannikṛṣṭamapyartha paśyanti| nairujyañca bhavati duḥkharāhityañca bhavati etat sarvaṃ vāyordhāraṇād bhavati|| 5|| **dapi prayojanaṃ darśayati kṛtveti| atra mūlacakramadhye ādhārakaramale ādareṇa manaḥ sthira kṛtvā bhūta vartamānaṃ bhaviṣyadapi vadanti| atītānāgatān vadanti| aśru tānyanadhītānyapi śāstrāṇi vadanti vyākhyānti|| 6|| prayojanāntaramāha vihāyeti | kamalāsanasya brahmaṇo mukhāmbu jaṃ prītireva taraṅgastatsambandhāt tyaktā tadīyavaktāmbu ruhīdarāntare vāyudhāraṇāt kartturmukhāmbhoruhābhyantare divyarupā sarasvatī nṛtyati abhiramati|| 7|| prayojanāntaramāha adhigamyeti | rasendramantrasiddhī adhigamya durnivārañca kālaṃ jitvā ajarāmaratāmavāpya avasānakāle paramānandapade mokṣapade ramante| tasmātr sthānayogāt jīvanmukto bhavati | avasāne paramātmani līnī bhavatītyarthaḥ|| 8|| ekībhūteti| pūrvamakhilaṃ jagat ekībhūtaṃ samudrāmbhāḥ plutamāsīt | tasyābhyantare maheśo devī liṅgarūpo vabhūva kīdṛśaḥ apūrvajyotiḥ svarūpaḥ apūrvateja eva liṅgarupatvena pariṇāmamagamadityarthaḥ| kīdṛśaḥ ṣaṅbhiḥ siddhairddhiraṇḍādibhiradhiṣṭhitātmā tasya liṅgavapurbhṛto bhagavata ādyam ūrddhaṃ mukhaṃ dviraṇḍanāmā siddhapuruṣaḥ āsīt | pūrvamukhaṃ vālī nāmā ūrddhānanam ava ānanamityarthaḥ| dakṣiṇaṃ vāyuḥ pinākī paścimāsyaṃ uttaraṃ yugalagaṇḍaḥ tathā ādhārātmā dviraṇḍaḥ svādhiṣṭhānātmā vālī maṇipūrātmā mahākālaḥ anāhatātmā vahniḥ viśuddhātmā pinākī ājñātmā kagalaṇḍaḥ| talliṅgam eṣu sthāneṣu cintanīyam || 9| 10||
pṛ0 40) svādhiṣṭhāna samāhvayaṃ rasadalairmūle dhvajasyāmbujam bālādityanibhaṃ daloparigataiḥ pṛṣṭhāditarkākṣaraiḥ| vindūdbhāsitamasta kairbhagavatoliṅgātmanaḥ śūlinaḥ sthānaṃ yogivareṇyagocaramidaṃ cāsyādhipā rākiṇī|| 11||
iha svādhiṣṭhāne nihitanijaceto layavaśādamandāndaughastimitahṛdayaḥ sādhakavaraḥ| sametāṅgo'naṅgaḥ kṣititalagato vā mṛgadṛśām smarasmerāpāṅgaṃ ramayati gaṇaṃ kāntikalitam|| 12||
iha vetti nidhāya mānasaṃ svaṃ vividhaṃ cāśrutaśāstrajālamuccaiḥ| avadhūtajarāmayaḥ sa martyaḥ suciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyubhītiḥ|| 13||
vapuṣo'śucitā janasya śaśvat paramāṃ śuddhimihātanīti puṃsām | śaradambu japelavasya dehe dṛḍha़ruddho ghanatāñca śītaraśmiḥ|| 14||
calitaṃ sahasā mahārasendraṃ kamalālokanato viyatsarojāt| iha ye vinidhārayanti santo nanu dhīrāḥ puruṣottamāsta eva|| 15||
pṛ0 41) madadhītakaṭo mahāgajendro vaśatāmeti yathā śanairupāyāt| balavāniha vai sudhākaro'sau kramaruddhaḥ svavaśo bhavatyavaśyam || 16||
etasmin kuliśābjayoganiratādādau layo jāyate rāgādindriyadantināṃ layavaśāt saṃvittirapyūrjitā| antarnīlamahārasadravajuṣāṃ nṝṇāntu ceto yadā āvirbhāvamupaityamandasahajānandacchalendūdayaḥ|| 17||
nābhisthaṃ maṇipūrakaṃ daśadalairnīlāñcanābhairyutam taḍaḍādyaiśca daśākṣarairdalagatairvindūllasanmastakaiḥ| lākinyā samadhiṣṭhitañca satataṃ dhyanairnarāḥ kevalam vaśyākarṣaṇanirviṣīkaraṇa pūḥkṣobhādikaṃ kurvate|| 18||
sthāne'sminnihitātmanaḥ sukṛtinaḥ pātālasiddhiṃ parām khaṅgasyāpratimasya sādhanamapi syādīpsitañca kṣitau| rūpaṃ bhūmivisarjanaṃ parapure śaktaḥ praveṣṭuṃ jarāhāniścākhiladuḥkharogaśamanaṃ kālasya vā vañcanam|| 19||
svādhiṣṭhānamiti| tadūrddhe rasadalaiḥ svakulaiḥ pṛṣṭhāditarkākṣaraiḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ vakāraḥ tadāditaḥ mayavalaḥ ebhirvindubhūṣitamastakaiḥ savindukairyu ktabālādityanibhaṃ prātaḥkālīnasūryyatulyam asya cakrasyādhipā rākiṇī|| 11|| iha kila samalakṣyāṇāṃ niyamitamarutāṃ yoginīkalātiśathaṃ darśayati iha svādhiṣṭhāna iti| layavaśāt padmodaraniveśavaśāt sametāṅgo'naṅgaḥ mṛgadṛśīgaṇaṃ ramayati| tathā smara smerāpāṅga smareṇa smeramalyaprakāśam apāṅga netrayorantaṃ yasya gaṇasya tam | tathā kāntyā lāvaṇyena kalitaṃ saṃravdham || 12|| viśeṣaphalamāha iheti| vigatajarāmayaḥ sa marttāḥ iha padme svaṃ mānasaṃ nidhāya arpayitvā aśru taśāstra samūhaṃ vividhaṃ nānāprakāraṃ vetti vītamṛtyu bhītiḥ tyaktayamabhayaḥ | anyapadmasya darśanāt aśucitā janasya śarīrasya nityaṃ śuddhiṃ tanīti puṃ saḥ śītarakṣmiḥ śukraḥ dṛḍha़bandhaḥ san ghanatāṃ niviḍa़tāṃ yātīti śaradamburuhavat pelavaḥsundaraḥ|| 13| 14|| calitamiti| sahasradalāccalitaṃ rasendraṃ śukram etatkamalālokanato ye vinidhārayanti te puruṣottamāḥ | etatpadmabhāvanayogaśaktāḥ|| 15| 16|| etasmin kuliśābjeti| tadaiva yogaḥ tasmin ratāt rāgādindriyadantināṃ layo bhavati ateva kuliśatvena nirupitam | saṃvittiḥ ūrjitā| antarnīlamiti| antarnīlaṃ yasmahābalaṃ śukraṃ tadeva rasaṃ tat sevitānāṃ nṛṇāṃ ceto yadā āvirbhāvaṃ prāpnoti tadā amandaṃ mahat yat sahajānandaṃ tacchalena avidyādhvaṃ sādyabhyudayāt indutvena nirupitaḥ|| 17|| maṇipūrakamāha nābhisthamiti | nīlāñjanatulyairdaśadaleryutam iṣṭairḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha etairdalagataiḥ vindullasanmastakaiḥ savindukairyuktaṃ lākinyā samadhiṣṭhitañca etaddhyānāt vaśyākarṣaṇanirviṣīkaraṇaṃ parapurakṣīkaraṇaṃ parapurapraveśaṃ tiraskaraṇī lukīvidyā iti yasya prasiddhiḥ| nanu ratnāt maṇipūrakamiti vacanāt kathaṃ nīlaratnamiti cet nīlaratnasyāpi ratnatvānna doṣaḥ| pātālasiddhiḥ adho vivarakaraṇaṃ
pṛ0 42) hṛdaye rasendragopasandhyāghanasindura suvarṇamavjam | yadanāhatamityuśanti santo ravisaṅkhaiyarupaśobhitaṃ dalaiḥ|| 20||
krodhīśādyairbhairavairbhānusaṃkhyairdaṇḍopetaṃ maṇḍitaṃ caṇḍavīryyaiḥ| tat kākinyādhiṣṭhitaṃ divyaśaktyā devyā haṃsenāpi devena śaśvat || 21||
etasmin satataṃ niviṣṭamanasaḥ sthāne vimānasthitāḥ kṣubhyantyadbhutarūpakānti kalitā divyastriyo yoginaḥ| jñānañcāpratimaṃ trikālaviṣayaṃ kṣobhaḥ purasya śrutirdūrādeva ca darśanañca khagatiḥ syād yogināṃ melanam || 22||
viśuddhākhyaṃ kaṇṭhe nalinamatha dhūmrānalaruciyutaṃ śrīkaṇṭhādisvaraparigataiḥṣoḍa़śadalaiḥ| iha sthāne śākinyatulanijaśaktirbhagavatī sthitā nityaṃ devī śaraṇagamanārttipraśamanī|| 23||
abhyāsayogādiha sanniviṣṭasvāntasya śaśvannarapuṅgavasya| samarthatā syādanadhītaśāstra sadbhāvabhāve vasudhātale'smin|| 24||
pṛ0 43) sthāne'tra saṃsaktamanā manuṣyastrikāladarśī vigatādhirogaḥ| jitvā jarāmañjananīlakeśaḥ kṣitau ciraṃ jīvati vītamṛtyuḥ|| 25||
iha sthāne cittaṃ satatamavadhāyāttapavano yadi kruddho yogī calayati samastaṃ tribhuvanam| na ca brahmā viṣṇurna ca hariharo naiva khamaṇistadīyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ śamayitumalaṃ nāpi gaṇapaḥ|| 26||
ājñānāma bhrū yugamadhye dalayugmopetaṃ padmaṃ śāradacandramayūkhābham| hākinyuktātrāpi ca devī dalayugme varṇāvantyau vinduyutau saṃsmaramīyau|| 27||
dhyānayoganiratasya jāyate pūrvajanmakṛtakarmaṇāṃ smṛtiḥ| kṣetravindunilaye ca dūrato darśanaśravaṇayoḥ samarthatā|| 28||
iha sannihitasvacittavṛttiḥ pratimāyāḥ pratijalpanaṃ karotati| gamanañca pure pareṣāṃ punarutthānamapyaho mṛtasya|| 29||
nirālambāṃ mudrāṃ nijagurumukhenaiva viditāmiha sthāne kṛtvā sthiraniśitadhīḥsādhakavaraḥ| sadābhyaso'paśyatya maranilayānantarakhilānuḍuśreṇīṃ viṣṇorapi padamuḍūnāmapi patim || 30||
mūkajarādinā khaḍa़्ga sādhanamapi tān īpsita sādhanaṃ rūpañca kecit parapure mṛtaśarīre praveṣṭuṃ śaktimiti vadanti|| 18|| 19|| anāhataca kramāha hṛdaya iti| indragīpī raktavarṇakīṭaviśeṣaḥ krodhīśādyaiḥ kakārādyaiḥ ṭhakārāntaiḥ ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha iti krodhīśadvādaśabhairava sahitairddhādaśākṣarairyuktaṃ dvādaśadalātmakaṃ karṇikāntargataṃ mūlamantra śaktyā kākinyā cādhiṣṭhitaṃ haṃsena cātmanā ca daṇḍopetaiḥ savindubhirmaṇḍitam || 20|| 21|| etasinniti | etaspnin sthāne niviṣṭamanaso yoginaḥ | karttṛbhūtāḥ vimānasthitāḥ divyastriyaḥ karmabhūtāḥ adbhutarupakāntyā kalitam| anyacca trikālaviṣayajñānañca atulyaṃ dūrāt śravaṇaṃ darśanañca yogināṃ sammelanañca|| 22|| viśuddhacakramāha viśuddheti | śrīkaṇṭhādisvaraparigataiḥ akārādisvarairdalaparigatairyutaṃ tadvayathā - aṃ āṃ iṃ īṃ uṃ ūṃ ṛṃ ṛṃ ḷṃ ḹṃ eṃ aiṃ oṃ auṃ aṃ aṃḥ iti ṣoḍa़śasvarairyuktaṃ dhūmasamānavarṇāṃ śākinīdevatādhiṣṭhitaṃ viśuddhākhyaṃ padmaṃ śaraṇagamanārttipraśamanī janmamaraṇaduḥkha praśamanī anadhīta śāstrasadbhāve sadbhāvatve iha sthāne cittamevāvadhāya avadhānaṃ kṛtvā āttapavanī gṛhīta pavanī yogī|| 23 -26|| ājñācakramāha ājñānāmeti | dalayugmopetaṃ dvidalayuktaṃ antyau varṇau hakārakṣakārau etaduktaṃ bhavati bhruvīrmadhye savindukābhyāṃ hakārakṣakārābhyāṃ yuktaṃ dvidalātmakaṃ śaradambuja saṅkāśaṃ hākinī devatādhiṣṭhitam ājñākamalaṃ mṛtasya punarāvṛttirna vidyate janmābhāvāt || 27- 29||
pṛ0 44) brahmāṇaṃ suravṛndavanditapadadvandvaṃ mukundaṃ tathā devaṃ devanikāyanāyakamapi pretādhipaṃ vāripam | ahnāṃ vahnimapi prabhuñca pavanaṃ tārkṣyañca yakṣeśvaram gandharvānapi kinnarānapi guṇaiḥ siddhān prasiddhānapi|| 31||
yakṣān rākṣasapuṅgavānapi munīn divyāṃśca bhavyākṛtīnantaḥ kāntikalākalāpa kalitān vidyādharān mātṛkām | rakṣottuṅgataraṅgatajalāṃ svarloka kallolinīm yogī paśyati śaśvadañciruciṃ tañcāpi hemācalam|| 32||
uttuṅgapīvarapayodharabhāranamrakamrāṅgamaṅgajamataṅgajamandayātam| ullāsicilliyugalaṃ cakitaiṇaśāva lolekṣaṇaṃ visaramapsarasāṃ tathaiva|| 33||
samuttuṅgaiḥ śrṛṅgaiḥ sthagitagaganābhogakakubhola sannānāratnā kalita kaṭakān bhūdharavarān | kuraṅgaiḥ sāraṅgairapi ca ramaṇīyāṃ vanabhuvam tathā gurvīmurvī mahitavividhakṣetrasahitām || 34||
taraṅgairuttuṅgai rahimakaramātaṅgunikaraiḥ karālānābhīrairapi jaladharairbhūdharavaraiḥ| tathā pārāvārānamalasarito vāribharitāḥ sahaṃsālīmālīmapi ca sarasāṃ sārasajuṣām|| 35||
pṛ0 45) lasanmarālaṃ vakakoṭimālaṃ taḍa़itkarālāntaravārilīnam| kalāpikāntaṃ sadhavānukūlaṃ pravāsikālaṃ navameghajālam || 36||
etasmin paramādbhutāvyayamahānandaikakande pare sthāne mānasamātmanaḥ sthiramatiḥ saṃyojayenmudrayā| yogī tanmayatāmupaiti śanakaiśceto nirālambayā paścānnaijamahāsukhaṃ layavaśādāvirbhavatyantaram || 37||
līne cetasi tatra vindunilaye vahne rivādī kalā dṛśyante tadanantarañca vilasadrūpāḥ pradīpāṅkurāḥ| bālasyeva divākarasya bahaladyotistato dyotate yadvā bhūgaganāntarāla vilasajjayot snāsapatraṃ mahaḥ|| 38||
nityānanda iti śriyaḥ patiriti śrīvāsudevaḥ pumān ātmetyacyu ta ityacintya mahimā yo gīyate yogibhiḥ|
nirālambāmiti| iha vindunilaye ājñāsthāne nirālambāṃ svecarīṃ mudrāṃ baddhā amaranilayaḥ svargaḥ tadūrddham akhilām uḍuśreṇīṃ nakṣatraśreṇīṃ paśyati viṣṇīḥ padam ākāśam | ahnāṃ prabhuṃ sūryyam ullāsicilliyugalaṃ bhrūyugalam | apsarasaḥ visaraṃ samūhaṃ paśyati bhūdharānapi paśyati tān kīdṛśān vṛhacchṛṅgaiḥ sthagitaṃ gaganamaṇḍalaṃ dik ca yaistān | kuraṅgādibhīramaṇīyāṃ vanabhuvañca paśyati| mataṅgī'tra jalahastī sarasāṃ ālīṃ samūhaṃ marālaṃ rājahaṃsam| vakakoṭiḥ vaka iti mayūrapriyakālaṃ prītijanakatvāt | sadhavāḥ patisahitāḥ tāsām anukūlaṃ pravāsikālaṃ pravāsinīnāṃ kālaṃ yamasvarupaṃ navameghajālaṃ nūtanameghasamūho yatra taṃ kīdṛśam iti taḍa़itkarālāntaravārilīnaṃ taḍa़itā saudāminyā karālaṃ bhayānakaṃ yadantarvāri tatra sīnaṃ nimagnam || 30 - 36|| etasminniti| paramam adbhutam avyayaṃ yanmahānandaṃ tasyaikakande mūlasvarupe pare sthāne ātmano mānasaṃ mudrayā nirālambayā sthāpayet | tadā yogī tanmayatāṃ brahmamayatām upaiti| vākāraḥ samuccaye | iti nirālambayā mudrayā nijaṃ mahāsukhaṃ brahmānandasukham antaraṃ antargataṃ layavaśādāvirbhavati prakāśate | asmin cetasi līne sati ādau vahneḥ kiraṇasthā liṅgā dṛśyante| tadanantarañca pradīpāṅgurāḥ aparaśca bālasya sūryyasya udyotaḥ prakāśaḥ tato dyotate prakāśate| yaddhā tanmahastejaḥ prakāśate āvirbhavati kīdṛśam ākāśamadhye vilasat yat jyotsrāraśmayastattulyam | asmin sthāne avyayaḥ parameśvaraḥ sākṣādvyaktaḥ sākṣisvarupī bhavati|| 37| 38|| sa eva ka ityāha nityānanda ityādi | yathā ambarāntaragato rāhuścandrārkayo-
pṛ0 46) sthāne'smin parameśa eṣa bhagavān vyakto bhavatyavyayaḥ sākṣī rāhurivāmbarāntaragataścandrārkayo rmaṇḍale|| 39|| viśvasyāyatanaṃ mahadbhagavataḥ sthānaṃ tadetatparam yatrāropya samīraṇaṃ sukṛtinaḥ prāṇaprayāṇe narāḥ| dīvyantaṃ paramaṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ vedāntavedyaṃ kavim viśvādyaṃ praviśanti santatamahānandaikakandaṃ vibhum || 40|| sahasrāra padmaṃ visargādadhastādadho vaktamāraktakiñjalkapuñjam | kuraṅgeṇa hīnastriśrṛṅgastadantaḥ sphuradraśmijālaḥ sudhāṃśuḥ samāste|| 41|| tadantargataṃ brahmarandhraṃ susūkṣmaṃ yadādhārabhūtaṃ suṣumnākhyanāḍyāḥ| tadetat padaṃ divyamatyantaguhyaṃ surairamyagamyaṃ sugopyaṃ suyatrāt|| 42|| etat kailāsasaṃjñaṃ paramakulapadaṃ vindurūpī svarūpī yatrāste devadevo bhava bhayatimiradhvaṃsa haṃso maheśaḥ| bhūtānāmādi devo rasavisarasitāṃ santatāmantaraṅge saudhīṃ dhārāṃ vimuñcannabhimataphalado yogināṃ yogagamyaḥ|| 43||
pṛ0 47) sthānasyāsya jñānamātreṇa puṃsāṃ saṃsāre'smin sambhavo naiva bhūyaḥ| bhūtagrāmaṃ santatanyāsayogāt karttuṃ harttuṃ syācca śaktiḥ samagrā|| 44||
sthāne pare haṃsanivāsabhūte kailāsanāmnīha vidhāya cetaḥ| yogī gatavyādiradhaḥ kṛtādhibādhaściraṃ jīvati mṛtyumuktaḥ|| 45||
sthāne'smin kṣayavṛddhibhāvarahitā nityoditādhomukhī bālādityanibhaprabhā śaśabhṛtaḥ sāste kalā ṣoḍa़śī| bālāgrasya vikhaṇḍitasya śatadhā caikena bhāgena yā sūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī nirantaragalatpīyūṣadhārādharā|| 46||
etasyāḥ parataḥ sthitā bhagavaṃtī bhūtādhidevādhipā nirvāṇākhyakalārddhacandrakuṭilā sā ṣoḍa़śāntargatā| bālāgrasya sahasradhā vigalitasyaikena bhāgena yā sūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī trilokajananī yā dvādaśārkaprabhā|| 47||
rmaṇḍale iti dṛṣṭāntackūlena piṅgalāyāścandra sūryyātmakatvāt | īḍa़āpiṅgalayormadhye muṣumnāthā bhokta tvāt suṣumnā rāhuriti pratipāditā|| 39|| viśrṛsyeti| viśvasya prapañcasvarūpasyāyatanaṃ tadeva bhagavataḥ sthānaṃ yatra sthāne ājñāsthāne samīraṇamāropya prāpayya sukṛtinī narāḥ dīvyantaṃ krīḍa़ntaṃ puruṣaṃ praviśanti iti| ateva purā ajarāmaraṃ jarāmṛtyu vihīnaṃ vedāntena vedyaṃ viśvādyaṃ viśvādau bhavaṃ janma yasya taṃ praviśanti | mahānandasyaikamūlaprabhavaṃ vibhum || 40|| sahasradalapadma māha sahasrārapadmamiti| āvaraṇadalaṃ sahasradalapaṅkajamityarthaḥ| visargasya rupātītasya kulādipadasyāvāg bhavyā ityarthaḥ| adhomukhe āraktakiñcalkaḥ puñje yatra raktakeśaramityarthaḥ| kuraṅgeṇa hīnaḥ vināśitakalaṅgaḥ nnisṛṅgeṇa yuktaḥ trikoṇākāraḥ sphuradraśmijālaḥ sphurat prabhāsamūhaḥ sudhāṃśuramṛtakaraḥ samāste|| 41|| tadantargatamiti | tanmadhye brahmarandhraṃ sūkṣmākāraṃ suṣumnākhyanāḍyā ādhārabhūtāyā suṣumnaiva niṣkalacaitanyātmaka parameśvarasyopādhibhūtacilkalā indumaṇḍalamadhya varttinī brahmarandha mādhārīkṛtya dehamanugatā ityarthaḥ| tathācoktaṃ yogārṇave śaktiryatra layāti tadevādhāra maṇḍalamiti| yadetadvisargastri maṅgala padaṃ tadeva kailāsākhya vindurūpī pumprakṛtyātmakaḥ visargaḥ| prakṛtirmātrā vindusargātmikā haṃsaḥ| tadātmakamidaṃ jagaditi| kīdṛk bhūtānāmādibhūtaḥ ādisvarūpaḥ| saudhīṃ dhārāṃ antaraṅge abhyantare muñcan | dhārāṃ kīdṛśīṃ rasavisarasitāṃ rasī dravyaviśeṣaḥ | tatra sitāṃ śulkāṃ yogagamyo bhagavān yogināmabhimataphalapradaḥ| atra kailāsasthāne niyamitamayatā itya parataḥ|| 42| 43|| atiśayaṃ darśayati sthānasyāsyeti| ityādi sugamam|| 44|| sthāne pare iti| svasya paramahaṃsasya nivāsabhūte gatā vyādhayo yasya saḥ| adhaḥ kṛtā ādhayovyādhayaśca yena saḥ| bālādityasamaprabhā śaśabhṛtaścandrasva ṣoḍa़śī kalā atisūkṣmā| śaśabhṛtaḥ kīdṛśasya bālāgrasya śataśo vikhaṇḍitasya ekaikabhāgena sūkṣmatvāt | kīdṛśī nirantaragalat pīyūṣa dhārādhareva bhāti pīyūṣadhārā pīyūṣa varṣameghatulyā|| 45| 46|| etasyā iti| etasyāḥ ṣoḍa़śakalāyāḥ parataḥ parasmin bhūtānāmadhipī maheśvarastasyadhipā bhaghavatī sthitā nirvāṇasaṃjñākalā nirvāṇaṣoḍa़śīkalā tāṃ gatā| kīdṛśī bālāgrasya sahasradhā vibhaktasya dalitasya ekena bhāgena sūkṣmatvāt sadṛśī dvādaśārkatulyā prabhā kāntiryasyāḥ|| 47||
pṛ0 48) nirvāṇākhyakalāpadoparigatā nirvāṇaśaktiḥ parā koṭyāditya samaprabhātigahanā bālāgrabhāgasya yā| koṭyaṃśena samā samastajananī nityoditā nirmalā nityānandapadasthaloruvigaladdhārā nirālambanā|| 48||
etasyāḥ parataḥ parātparataraṃ nirvāṇaśakteḥ padam śaivaṃ śāśvatamapremayamamalaṃ nityoditaṃ niṣkiyam| tadviṣṇoḥ padamityuśanti sudhiyaḥ kecit padaṃ brahmaṇaḥ keciddhaṃsapadaṃ nirañjanapadaṃ kecinnirālambanam|| 49||
āropyāropya śaktiṃ kamalajanilayādātmanā sākameṣu sthāneṣvājñāvasāneṣvavahita hṛdayaścintayitvā krameṇa| nītvā nādāvasānaṃ khagatakulamahāpadmasadmāntarasthām dhyāyeraccaitanya rūpāmabhimataphalasamprāptaye śaktimādyām || 50||
sākṣāllākṣārasābhaṃ gaganagatamahāpadmasadmastha haṃsām pītvā divyāmṛtaughaṃ punarapi ca viśenmadhyadeśaṃ kulasya | cakre cakre krameṇāmṛtarasavisaraistarpayeddevatāstā hākinyādyāḥ samastāḥ kamalajapadagāṃ tarpayet kuṇḍalīṃ tām || 51||
iti śrīnāgabhaṭṭaviracite tripurāsārasamuccaye pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ|
pṛ0 49) ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ| svayambhūliṅgaṃ nijayonimadhyavaktāntare hṛtsarasīruhāntaḥ| bālāhvayaṃ cetaramantarāle vadanti santo gaganāmbu je'nye|| 1||
yadvījaṃ vāgbhāvakhyaṃ drutakanakanibhaṃ tat svayambhū taliṅgam sthāne dhyātvā hṛdambhoruhakuharagate vāṇaliṅge dvitīyam | kāmākhyaṃ bandhujīvaprasarasamaruciṃ śāradenduprabhāvam tārtīyīkantu vījaṃ tvitarapadagataṃ cintayecchāntarūpaḥ|| 2||
prāṇān yonigatān vidhāya manasā dhyāyanti tāṃ bhāratīm vījākhyāṃ nijayonirandhra nilaṃyādānābhirandhrotthitām|
nirvāṇeti | nirvāṇākhya kalāpadaṃ sthānaṃ tasyopari adhīgatā nirvāṇa śaktiḥsthitā| koṭyā dityasramā prabhā yasyāḥ sā atevātigahanā kīdṛśī bālāgrabhāgasya śaśabhṛtaḥ koṭyaṃ śena samā nityānandapada sthānaṃ śaiva padam | tatra ururmahatī vigala ddhārā yasyāḥ nirālambanā avalambanarahitā|| 48| 49||
āropyeti | kamalajanilayāt mūlādhārāt śaktim āropya ātmanā sākam eṣu sthāneṣu śaktiṃ cintayitvā krameṇa nādāvasānaṃ nītvā ākāśagatabrahma mahāpadmameva sadma gṛhaṃ tasyāntarasthāṃ caitanyarūpāṃ dhyāyet|| 50||
sākṣāditi| divyāmṛtaughaṃ pītvā gaganagatamahāpadmasthitahaṃsāṃ kulasya śarīrasya madhyadeśaṃ mūlādhāraṃ viśet | tataḥ praticakre sthitā ḍākinyādyāḥ yadi samantādeva tato'mṛtarasasamūhaistarpayet| tataḥ kamalajapadagāṃ mūlādhārasthāṃ kuṇḍalinīñca tarpayet|| 51||
iti tripurāsāraṭīkāyāṃ padārthādarśe pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ||
evañcādhāreṣu yogaviśeṣānuktāṃ mūlādhārādyādhāreṣu svayambhuliṅgavāṇādiviśeṣān vaktumupakramate svayaṃmbhuliṅgamiti| yonibrahmarandhrāntarāniti śṛṅgākāre prāyuktasthāne svayambhuliṅgaṃ yāti layaṃ yatra japediti talliṅgaṃ liṅgañca carācaramiti hṛtsarojavān liṅgamiti| itaraṃ liṅgaṃ paraliṅgamityarthaḥ| antarālabhruvīrmadhye iti| anye tu itarapadam evaṃ varṇayanti| antarāle vindau sthitaṃ taditaraṃ liṅgam anye tu gaganāmbuje visargākhye paravindunirmalapade ityarthaḥ|| 1||
śrīmūlavidyāyāstrayāṇāṃ vījānāṃ svayambhu vāṇaliṅgayīrdhyānamāha| yadvījamiti| yadvāgbhavākhyaṃ prathamavījaṃ nirmalakāñcanasaṅkāśaṃ mūlādhāre svayambhuliṅgātsakaṃ dhyāyet | yat kāmākhyaṃ madhyavījaṃ kusumasaṅkāśaṃ hṛdayakamalakarṇikāmadhye vāṇaliṅgaṃ tṛtīyavījaṃ śāradendusaṅkāśam ājñāsthāne paraliṅgātmakaṃ dhyāyedityarthaḥ|| 2||
pṛ0 50) bālārkāruṇatejasīṃ bhagavatīṃ ye siddhaliṅgākṛtim teṣāmeva kavitvasampadatulā pīyūṣaniḥsyandinī|| 3||
sindūrāruṇa sundarī bhirakhilaṃ prodbhāsayantīṃ kulam hṛtpadmāntaragāṃ prabhābhiraniśaṃ ye vāṇaliṅgākṛtim| āvindoruditāmananyamanaso dhyāyanti divyāṅganāḥ kāmārttā vilapanti lolamanasasteṣāṃ padānte bhuvi|| 4||
ye gaurīmitarābhidhāṃ nijarucā dhyāyanti liṅgākṛtim vindusthānagatāṃ sudhākarakagśrīhāriṇodbhāvitām | arddhendupratimāṃ visargagamahāpadmaśrutāṃ vibhratīm dhārāṃ vidrumapāṭalāmṛtamayīṃ te sampadāṃmāspadam|| 5||
trayāṇāṃ liṅgānāmatibahalatejaḥ śrutijuṣām triṣu sthāneṣveṣu sthiranihitadhīḥ sādhakavaraḥ| japenmantraṃ lakṣaṃ sarasakusumairbrahmatarujaistri madhvaktairhomaṃ tadanu niśi cāreṇa juhuyāt|| 6||
niḥśaṅkaṃ hariṇāṅkamambaratalāt pātālamūlaṃ gatam tatra sthena divākareṇa puṭitaṃ kṛtvā samādāya ca| pṛ0 51) rāhorāsyagataṃ kapālikaraṇaprastāvanā paṇḍitaḥ kuṇḍe hastakaraṇḍakena juhuyāddhomo'yamatyadbhutaḥ|| 7||
ekaṃ vatsaramevameva śivadhīrmartyo juhotīha yaḥ sadyo mṛtyumasau vijitya vapuṣaḥ puṣṭiṃ viśiṣṭāṃ dadhat| darpaṃ darpakasannibho mṛgaddaśāṃ bhañjan subhṛṅgāṅganāśreṇī śrīmadarālakuntalacayo jīvedanekāḥsamāḥ|| 8||
eteṣāṃ vījatrayāṇāṃ japadhyānaphalaviśeṣaphalañcāha prāṇān yonigatānityādi| sindurāruṇasundarībhiḥ prabhābhiḥ akhilaṃ kulaṃ mūlādhārādicakramityarthaḥ| āvindoruditāṃ vindusthānaparyyantaṃ sudhākara śrīhāriṇā maheśena udbhāvitā| evambhūtāṃ liṅgākṛtiṃ ye dhyāyanti te sampadāṃ padaṃ sthānamiti| ślokatrayeṇa sākalyena japatāṃ dhyāna viśeṣañcāha nnayāṇāṃ liṅgānāmiti| japellakṣamiti| yalliṅge yadvījasthānaṃ tatra tasya lakṣajapaḥ| tena trivījenalakṣaṃ samudāyajapastu trilakṣamiti niyamaḥ| brahmatarujaiḥ palāśakusumaiḥ| niśi cāreṇa īḍa़āyāṃ vāyau gate sati|| 3- 6|| kāmyaviśeṣānāha niḥśaṅkamiti| hariṇāṅgaḥ iḍā़nāḍī़sthitavāyuḥ kāryyekāraṇopacāraḥ| ambaratalāt nāsāsthānāt pātālamūlaṃ mūlādhāraṃ brahmarandhagataṃ tatrasthena divākareṇa piṅgalāvāyunā puṭitam ubhayavāyoraikyaṃ kṛtvā taṃ vāyunādāya rāhīrāsyagate kuṇḍalīmukhe hastakaraṇḍakena hastarupeṇa manasā juhuyāt | kapālikaraṇa prastāvanāpaṇḍitaḥ kapālikaraṇākhyaprakriyāyāṃ prājñaḥ ūrddhādhaḥ karaṇaṃ vidurityatra paṇḍita ityarthaḥ| guptārthamtu kiñcit prakāśyate| hariṇāṅgadravya viśeṣaḥ sthānaviśeṣaḥ sthānaviśeṣagataṃ sthānaviśeṣasthadivākareṇa dravyaviśeṣeṇa puṭitaṃ miśritaṃ hutvā rāhorāsyagate kuṇḍe sthānaviśeṣe hastakaraṇḍakena hastarūpaśruveṇa nuhuthāditi | dravyasaṃjñā aprakāśyā etadarthakathane śiṣṭīpahāsa iti tantracūḍa़āmaṇiśca rāhuḥ śiraḥ śirī vā gṛhītvā kṣāḍa़ena viśet| sūryyātmakaṃ samādātuṃ yadā tasyāṃ tithau yute| pātālagamyā deveśa vyomasthānāddivākaram | patitaṃ rāhucakre tu buddhai्yakyaṃ prāpayettataḥ| rāhuvakteṇa tat kuṇḍe homaṃ kuryyāttu taddine| tatra yajjāyate dravyaṃ tadeva kuṇḍagolakam | kuṇḍaṃ śivasahāyena golakaṃ śivahaṃsataḥ| etatrayāṇoṃ madhye tu svayambhukusumaṃ mahat | kvacid gandharvarājena labhyate vā na vā vibhī| yadi*tallabhyate devi ! lākṣārasasamanvitam | kasturīkuṅkumāktāñca vaṭīṃ kṛtvā tu gopayet | mantrarājaṃ samālikhya prayogaṃ tena nirvapet | tattithiṃ samanuprāpya svayamuttiṣṭhate kulam | amṛtañcobhayordeva ! bhoktuṃ devī na saṃśayaḥ| suptādidoṣaduṣṭā ye mantrā vidyāśca kīlitāḥ| prabuddhāstat prayogeṇa yāvat sā punarāgatā| dvitīyāyāṃ gate devi ! dṛśyā yā sā kalāvatī| tithikrameṇa sā devī paurṇamāsyāḥ phalapradā iti | etadarthaprakāśena devatāśāpī jāyate iti| tat kathaṃ bahusūcitamiti|| 7|| kīṇaniyamaṃ phalañcāha ekamiti | darpaḥ kandarpaḥ tattalyaḥ san mṛgaddaśāṃ darpabhañjan anekāḥ samā jīvet cirajīvī bhavedityarthaḥ| kīddak arālaḥ kuṭilākāraḥkuntalavayaḥ keśasamūho yasya saḥ| bhṛṅgāṅgānaśreṇīnāṃ śrīrvidyate yasya paścāt bhṛṅgāṅganā śreṇī śrīmāṃścāsau arālakuntalaśceti karmadhārayaḥ|| 8||
pṛ0 52) tato devīṃ dhyāyet pariṇataśaraccandrasadṛśa prasannasmerāsyāmalikala bhasaṅkāśakavarīm| virājantīṃ netrairvikacanavanīlotyapalanibhaistribhirdanta śreṇīrucivijitahārāvalirucim || 9||
bandhūkasāndhyaghanabandhurakāntikāntam| mandasmitāṃśuviśadīkṛtamudvahantīm | dantacchadaṃ rucirakuṇḍalamaṇḍalañca gaṇḍasthalīyugalakhaṇḍasudhāṃśupāṇḍu|| 10||
uttuṅgasaṅgatapayodharabhāranamrakamrā vanamravilasatrivalītaraṅgām| gambhīranābhivivarāṃ vararāmarambhāstambhopamoruyugalāmaruṇāṅghipadmām || 11||
kalāṃ maulāvindorgaladamalapīyūṣavisarām vahantīṃ santāna prasavaracitaṃ śekharamapi| vasānāṃ sadvāsohima kiraṇanirmokaviśadam mahāvindvārūḍhā़ṃ jaṭharaśaśabhṛśatkoṭidhavalām || 12||
hastābhyāmakṣamālāṃ sphaṭikamaṇimayīṃ jñānamudrāñca bhadrām vibhrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇābhyāṃ maṇimayamukuṭāṃ pustakañcābhayañca| vāmābhyāṃ ratnakāñcī parivṛta jaghanāṃ ratnakeyūrahārām divyālaṅkārayuktāṃ tribhuvana jananīṃ divyagandhānuliptām || 13||
pṛ0 53) samudgirantīmapi śāstrajālaṃ nirantaraṃ kāntikalāsamagrām | vinamradevāsura vṛndamaulimālārajorājita pāda padmām|| 14||
dhyātvā vāgīśvarīṃ tāṃ gaganagatamahāvindupīṭhādatītasthānaṃ cānīya tasmādapi tadanu nayedāgatasthānamenām | śāntātītantu tasmādanupamamahimā sūryyacakrantu tasmādvyomāmbhojaṃ tataścākhila bhuvananutāmānayet pretabhūmim || 15||
pretasthānādarddhacandraṃ tatastāmārambhaṃ tu prāpayet setubandham | tasmāccaivaṃ vyoma tasmādameyasthānaprāptāṃ cintayedīśvarasya|| 16||
tasmādrūdrasyālayaṃ rudragehādviṣṇu sthānaṃ prāpayeddeva devīm | viṣṇusthānā dbrahmaṇaḥ sthānamenāṃ brahmasthānāt kuṇḍalīgehamadhyam || 17||
sahasradalaśobhite rucirakarṇikākeśare lasanmahasi kuṇḍalībhavanapaṅkaje tāṃ sthitām | visargagakhagākhya vindu vilasatsudhādhārayā tataḥ samabhiṣecayedu bhagavatīma vicchinnayā|| 18||
tato devīṃ dhyāyediti sugamam|| 9|| kīdṛśīṃ devīṃ dantracchadaṃ vahantīṃ kīddaśaṃ bandhūka puṣpaṃ sundhyāsambandhi yadṛghanaṃ teṣāṃ yanmanodarakānti taddat kāntaṃ kamanīyam | mandasmitāṃśunā viśadīkṛtam | punaḥ kīdṛśīṃ uttuṅgapayodharabhāranamrakamnāvanamravilasattrivalītaraṅgām uttuṅgī yaḥ payodhara bhārastena namraṃ kamraṃ anavalambaṃ kamanīyamudaraṃ tatra trivalyākārastaraṅgī yasyāḥ tām | ururmahān yo rāmakadalīstambhaḥ sa eva upamā yayoḥ ūrvoḥ tām aruṇamaṅgi padmaṃ yasyāḥ tām | tathā indoḥ kalāṃ maulau vahantīṃ kīdṛśīṃ kalāṃ galatpīyūṣasamūhām | tadutprekṣate santānaka prasabaracitaṃ śekharamiva kalpavṛkṣapuṣparacitaṃ śekharamiva kirīṭamiva| himakaraścandraḥ nirmokī muktakañcukaḥ tadvadviśadaṃ nirmalaṃ tathā sadvāsī vasānāṃ tathā mahāvindvārūḍha़āṃ gaganopari vindusthānamārūḍhā़ṃ tathā jaṭhara śaśabhṛt koṭidhavalāṃ paripūrṇakoṭa candratulyām || 10- 14|| evaṃ vāgīśvarīṃ dhyātvā vindupīṭhāt vindupīṭhe'rddhe atīte sthāna ānayet| tasmādatītasthānāt ātapasthānaṃ tata ātapasthānāt śāntātītaṃ tasmācchāntātītāt sūryyacakraṃ tato vyomāmbhojaṃ tataḥ pretasthānaṃ śivasthānaṃ pretasthānādarddhacandraṃ tasmādārambhaṃ tataḥ setubandhaṃ tataḥ punarvyoma tata āmayam īśvarasya tato rudrālayaḥ rudragehācchakti sthānam || 15|| 16|| tasmāt kuṇḍalinībhavanaṃ kimityāha sahasreti | sahasradalaśobhite visargagato
pṛ0 54) anena śaśvadvihitena devīdhyānena nāśaṃ samupaiti mṛtyuḥ| yāḥ siddhayo divyagaṇādhipasya bhavanti tā apyacireṇa puṃsām|| 19||
ādhārādullasantīmakulagatamahāpadmaparyyantamanta dhyāyantīṃ brahmanāḍyā sphuradamalaruciprakhyarūpāṃ bhavānīm | ye devīṃ liṅgarūpāṃ bhuvi vimaladhiyo bhāvanāmātragamyām nirddhūtāśeṣapāpā nikhilaguṇayutā jñāninaste bhavanti|| 20||
ye gokṣīratuṣārahāradhavala proddāma tejaśchaṭācchāyodbhāsitaroma kūpavivarāśeṣāṅkaliṅkākṛtim | vāgīśīṃ dhavalāmbu jāntaragalat pīyūṣadhārādravairāsiñcanti samantato'khilavapurmṛ tyośca te mṛtyavaḥ|| 21||
liṅgākāradharāṃ surāsurayutāṃ sauṣumnanāḍyantare devīmañjana puñjamecakaruciṃ siñcanti śaśvadbhuvi| ye divyāmṛtadhārayā pracurayā kālāgradūtī nṛṇām rūponmūlanadṛṣṭipāṭavadharā teṣāṃ kuto visrasā|| 22||

pṛ0 72) caturddhārayuktaṃ tatastasya madhye tridhā tadvibhāgena bhāgaikavedīm | aratnipramāṇonnatāṃ darpaṇāntarnibhāṃ tāṃ manohāriṇīṃ cāpi kuryyāt || 3||
vedāsraṃ yonimarddhāḍupanibhamanalāsraṃ ca vṛttaṃ ṣaḍa़sram padmākāraṃ gajāsraṃ harihayaharidārabhya tasyā vidadhyāt| madhye vṛttañca gaurīpatisurapadiśoḥ paṇḍitā kecidāhurvāyavye pañcakoṇaṃ diśi madanaripoḥ saptakoṇañca kuṇḍam || 4||
prāk sūtraṃ prathamaṃ nidhāya vidadhītārddhena tasyāṅkitam madhye matsyayugaṃ diśoramaladhīḥ kīnāśavitteśayoḥ| tābhyāṃ sūtramaṇiṃ prasāryya caturaḥ koṇāṃstato lāñchayet kṣetraṃ syāccaturasramatra racayedanyāni kuṇḍānyapi|| 5||
kṣetre kṣiptvā vahiriha purobhūtabhāge'śaṃmekam koṇārddhārddhaṃ suniśitamati rbhrāmayet sampragṛhya| pṛ0 73) yāvat koṇaṃ paramapi tathā sūtrayugmasya pātam madhyāt kuryyād bhavati tadidaṃ manmathāvāsakuṇḍam|| 6||
parityajya bhāgadvayaṃ paṅ ktibhāgī kṛte'tropariṣṭādadhastācca vidvān| paribhrāmayettena mānena samyag bhavedarddhacandrāhvayaṃ kuṇḍametat|| 7||

diggajādadhikapaṃktibhāgataḥ kṣetrato niśitadhīrvahirnyaset| bhāgamekakamanena sarvato bhrāmayed bhavati vṛttamuttamam|| 9||
bhūpāṃśe'śaṃdvayamiha vahiḥ pārśvayornyasya madhyāt kṣetravyāse suvimalamatistena mānena kṛtvā|
vedikānirmāṇa prakāramāha tatastasya madhya ityādinā tanmaṇḍapatribhāgaikena bhāgena vedikāṃ kuryyāt yathā prāk pratyayasūca catuṣṭayenāsakānyā dakṣiṇottarā pañca tathaiva cānayet evaṃ kṛte
