vakṣyamāṇena kuryyāt | devāsraṃ caturasraṃ yonim aśvatthapatrākāram arddhoḍa़upanibham arddhacandrākāram analāsraṃ trikoṇaṃ vṛttaṃ ṣaḍa़sraṃ padmākāraṃ gajāsram aṣṭāsraṃ harihayaharidārabhya prācīṃ diśamārabhyetyarthaḥ | śāradātilake tu ācāryyakuṇḍaṃ madhye syād gaurīpatimahendrayorityā cāryyavṛttaṃ varttulam | anye tve vasāhuḥ indreśānayormadhyāvṛttaṃ vāyavye pañcakoṇam īśakoṇe maṇḍalakoṇaṃ kuryyāt|| 4|| kuṇḍaprastāramāha prāksūtramityādinā| prathamaṃ prāk prācyagrasūtramāsphālya vanmadhyāhitaṃ dhṛtvā tanmānena diśordakṣiṇottaradikṣu sūtra catuṣṭayam āsphālayet | evaṃ kṛte caturhastapādopetaṃ samaṃ caturasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ jāyate| etat kuṇḍaṃ pūrvadiggataṃ bhavati etadeva caturasram || 5|| caturasrañca kṛtvānyāni kuṇḍānyuddharedityāhuḥ kṣetre kṣiptveti | kṛtacaturasre āgneyamāruta nairṛteśañca sūtradvayam āsphālya punaścaturasraṃ pañcāvitaya ekam aṃśaṃ vahiḥ kṣiptvā koṇārddhārddha pramāṇena sampūjya bhrāmayet koṇaśabdena koṇasūtraṃ gṛhyate| tasyārddhaṃ koṇasūtradvayamadhyasampātasthānaṃ tadarddhaṃ paścimakoṣṭhayugale dvitīya koṇasūtrasthānaṃ tat pramāṇataḥ tat sthānāt koṇasaṃlagnaṃ bhrāmayet etad yoni kuṇḍam agnidiggatam ||6|| arddhacandrakuṇḍamāha parityajyeti| caturasraṃ kṛtaṃ bhūbhāgaṃ daśadhā vibhajya adha ūrddhaṃ bhāgadvayam ūrddha ekam adha ekaṃ parityajya agre jyāsūtraṃ sve sve sapramāṇaṃ pātayitvā tena mūle vyāsa pramāṇena bhrāmayet| sūtra khaṇḍānyanyāni parimārjayet | etadarddhacandrāhvayaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇadiggatam || 7|| asrakuṇḍamāha śarvarīti| sārddhabhāgīkṛta iti prakṛtaṃ caturasraṃ kṣetram aṣṭadhā vibhajya pārśvayoḥ tiryyak prācīsūtrapārśvayoḥ pratyekaṃ bhāgadvayaṃ varddhayet| sūtrasakalāni parimārjayet| aindrakoṇakuṇḍaṃ nirṛtidiggatam || 8|| vṛttakuṇḍamāha digiti| kṣetrato'ṣṭādhikadaśabhāge kṛte evaṃ bhāgaṃ catuḥpārśve vahirnyasya vṛttākāreṇa bhrāmayet| vṛttakhaṇḍānyanyāni parivarjayet | etadra vṛtta kuṇḍaṃ paścimadiggatam|| 9||
pṛ0 74) pārśvadvandve bhktaṣayugayugaṃ sūtraṣaṭ komapātam kuryyāt kuṇḍaṃ bhavati tadidaṃ tarkakoṇaṃ manojñam || 10||
daśāṃśe'tra vinyasya vāhye'śaṃmekam paribhrāmya tenaiva vṛttaṃ dalānām | vahirmadhyame karṇikāñcāpi kuryyād bhavedaṣṭapatraṃ budhaḥ padmakuṇḍam || 11||
kṣetre kṣiptvātra vāhye diśi diśi mihiradvandvakāṃśe'śaṃmekam kṛtvānenābdhikoṇaṃ punarapi matimān koṇato'rddhaṃ gṛhītvā| tatkoṇābhyāṃ vidadhyādiha khalu paritastena mānena cihnānaṣṭasraṃ syāt samantādapica vitanuyādaṣṭasūtra prayogam || 12||
hayāṃśe'tra bhāgaṃ vahirnyasya vṛttaṃ paribhrāmya bhūyo yugāṃśīkṛtāṃśaiḥ| tribhiḥ paṭṭadorghaṃ bhavet pañcasūtraprayogādihānena pañcāsrakuṇḍam|| 13||
pṛ0 75) kṣetravyāse daśāṃśairvahiriha vinidhāyaikamaṃśaṃ suvṛttam mānenānena kṛtvā punarapica catuḥṣaṣṭibhāgīkṛte'tra| paṭṭāyāmapramāṇaṃ dṛḍha़matiramunā satrikaistriṃ śadaṃśaiḥ kuryyāt saptāsra kuṇḍaṃ bhavati hi tadidaṃ saptasūtraprayogāt|| 14||
yāvanmānaṃ kuṇḍavistārakasya tāvat khātasyāpi mānaṃ pradiṣṭam | kuṇḍākāraṃ paṇḍito yādṛśaṃ tat tādṛgrū paṃ mekhalāyā nidadhyāt || 15||

ṣaḍa़srakuṇḍamāha bhūpeti | kṣetraṃ dṛśāṃ bhūpāṃśīkṛtya ṣoḍa़śadhā kṛtvā madhyasūtrāt| pārśvamevaikamekaṃ vinyasya pārśva dvandve matsyacatuṣkaṃ tataḥ ṣaṭ sūtraṃ pātayet| tena ṣaṭ komātmakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ bhavet tadvāyavyadiggatam|| 10|| padma kuṇḍamāha daśāṃśeti| caturasraṃ kṣetraṃ daśāṃśīkṛtya varddhayitvā varttulākāreṇa bhrāmayitvā punarapi tena mānena bhrāmayitvā kuṇḍātmakamadhyavṛttena karṇikādvitayavṛttena keśarāṇi tṛtīye cāṣṭadalāni padmakuṇḍaṃ kauveradiggatam|| 11|| aṣṭāsramāha kṣetra iti | caturasraṃ kṣetraṃ mihiradvandvāṃśaṃ caturviśāṃśaṃ vidhāya diśi diśi ekamekam alaṃ kṣiptvā varddhayitvā abdhikoṇaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ koṇato'rddhaṃ gṛhītvā antaścaturasrakoṇārddhārddhaṃ gṛhītvā koṇābhyāṃ vāhyacaturasrakoṇābhyāṃ diśi diśi cihnāni kṛtvā aṣṭamūce pātenāṣṭāsraṃ kuṇḍaṃ īśadiggatam || 12|| pañcāsra kuṇḍamanyācāryyamatamāha hayāṃśe iti caturasraṃ saptabhāgaṃ vidhāya ekam aṃśaṃ vahirvattulatvena varddhayitvā punarapi yugāṃśīkṛtya caturddhā vibhajya tribhiraṃśairāyāma dairdhyaṃ kṛtvā tañca sūtraprayogaṃ pañcakoṇātmakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāyukoṇagatam|| 13|| saptāsra kuṇḍamāha kṣetra vyāsa iti | atra vyāsaprakṛtaṃ caturasraṃ daśadhā vibhajya ekāṃśena vahirvarddhayitvā punastenaiva mānena parito vṛttaṃ bhrāmayet | punarapi caturasraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭadhā vibhajya teṣvekatriṃ śadaṃśaṃ parityajya avaśiṣṭena trayastriṃśadaṃśena vṛttarekhāṃ saptadhā prāṇīya saptacihnāni kṛtvā saptasūtrāṇyāsphālayet| evaṃ saptakoṇam asaṅgu citāgraṃ kuryyāditi|| 14|| khātamānamāha yāvaditi| yugaṃ catvāri arpitaṃ trāṅkulaṃ netraṃ dvāṅgulaṃ sindhuvācau tarkāḥ ṣaṭ abdhayaścatvāraḥ| nābhiprasaramāha nābhimiheti| antaḥ kuṇḍamadhye
pṛ0 76) muṣṭimātre rasāmbhodhinetrāṅgulāyāmatāronnatiryoniruktā budhaiḥ| netravedāṅgulotsedhatārānvitā nābhirapyatra yonyagramekāṅgulam|| 21||

tisrastatra likhedudaggataśikhārekhāhṛdā varhiṣā prāgagrāśca tathā caturmukhayamaśyāmākarā devatāḥ| tāsāṃ vṛtrariporharid gataśikhāyāmadhya savyottarāḥ śrīśādrīśasurādhipā iti tathā prāgagrarekhādhipāḥ|| 3||
pṛ0 79) abhyukṣya mūlenāmbhobhirgandhādyaistasya madhya mabhyarcya| iha nīlanīradābhāṃ dhyāyedvāgīśvarī mṛtusnātām || 4||
jātaṃ mārttaṇḍakāntāddhutavahamaraṇeḥ śrotriyāgārato vā kṣetrānnikṣipya pātre varakanakamaye tāmrapātre'thavāpi| mṛtapātre vā nidhāyāmalavipulamatirvahnivījena mantrī kravyādāṃśaṃ tyajaṃstattadanu ca manunā śodhayedastrakeṇa|| 5||
kavacena tato'vaguṇṭhā paścād - yatātmā paridarśya dhenumudrām | amṛtīkaraṇaṃ tato viddhyājjalavījena savindunā kṛśānoḥ|| 6||
prādakṣiṇyāttriḥ paribhrāmya samyag vāgīśvaryyāḥ kuṇḍamadhye sthitāyāḥ| yonāvenaṃ vinyaset svābhivaktam paścādagniṃ mūlamantreṇa mantrī|| 7||
kāmyaviśeṣe kuṇḍaviśeṣamāha sarvasiddhikaraṃmiti| manasijakara saṃkhyātayonikuṇḍaṃ jātiviśeṣe kuṇḍaviśeṣamāha caturasramiti|| 32 -36||
iti śrītripurāsāramuccaṭīkāyāṃ padārthādarśe navamaḥ paṭalaḥ|| 9||
evaṃ maṇḍapakuṇḍavidhānānantaraṃ sthaṇḍilavidhānaṃ homavidhānañca vaktumupakramate nityetyādinā| nitye naimittika hastapramāṇaṃ kuṇḍamācāryyāḥ prāhuḥ | bālukānirmitasthaṇḍilapramāṇamāha sthaṇḍilamiti|| 1|| kuṇḍaśodhanaprakāramāha tata iti , kuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ ca kvatvā nakhakeśaloṣṭrāśmādīn saṃśodhya gomayāmbhasā kuṇḍamupalipya sthaṇḍilaṃ cābhyukṣya vāyuvījena saṃśodhya varuṇavījenālpāvanaṃ kṛtvā hṛdā hṛdayamantreṇa nama iti mantreṇa varhiṣā dviguṇitakuśena dakṣiṇāgraṃ paścimādipūrvāgrakrameṇa rekhātrayaṃ vilikhya tāsāṃ dakṣiṇā duttarāgreṣu madhyaścimapūrva bhāgagatānāṃ krameṇa brahmayamasomāḥ paścimādipūrvāgreṣu madhyadakṣiṇottarāṇāṃ diśaḥ śrīśamurādhipādevatāḥ smaret tato dakṣiṇabhāgena gandhapuṣpākṣatādīni homadravāyāṇi saṃsthāpya vāmabhāge pūrvāgrān darbhānāstīryya tadupari yathoktanipātān tīrthajalenāpūryya pūrvoktadravyajātam | pātrāṇi ca pūrvoktamantreṇa samprokṣya kuṇḍasthaṇḍiyayoranyatame madhye gandhādibhirabhyarcya|| 2|| 3|| vāgīśvarīmṛtusnātāṃ vāgīśvareṇa saṃyuktāṃ dvibhujām utpadhāriṇīmiti dhyātvā|| 4|| sūryyakāntasambhavaṃ araṇeḥ śrītriyagehādvā ekamagnimānīya vahnivījenapātre nidhāya kravyādane kiñciddārukhaṇḍaṃ parityajya astreṇa sañchādya|| 5|| kavacenāvaguṇṭhā amṛtavījena dhenumudrayā amṛtīkṛtya utthāpya prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa sthaṇḍilakuṇḍaṃ paribhrāmya svasammukhaṃ kṛtvā| svavījabuḍdhā kuṇḍamadhye devyā yonau tat samarpayet|| 6|| 7||
pṛ0 80) hṛnmantreṇa samāhito'tha juhuyādānjena saptāhutīrgarbhādhānamidaṃ sitetaragateḥ samyak kṛtaṃ syādiha| evaṃ puṃsavanaṃ tato vitanuyānmantrī tu sīmantakam tenaivāsya tu jātakarmavidhinā vahnervidadhyādiha|| 8||
tataḥ saptahastaṃ tripādaṃ dviśīrṣaṃ catubhirviṣāṇaistridhābaddhamiddham | piśaṅgairyutaṃ locanaistarkasaṃkhyairvināśaṃ raṇantaṃ catuḥśrotramagnim || 9||
raktāmbu jāsyaṃ parisambitaikapādañca pṛṣṭhena gataṃ vṛṣendram | svasammukhaṃ dakṣiṇagaiścaturbhirvāmaistribhirbāhubhirapyupetam|| 10||
śaktiṃ randhraṃ sruksruvau savyahastairvāmaistaistomaraṃ tālavṛntam | sarpiḥ pūrṇaṃ taptasauvarṇavarṇaṃ pātraṃ svāñca saptajihvāṃ dadhānam || 11||
yā sā hiraṇyā kanakā ca raktā hṛṣṭā ca savyānanagā rasajñā| yā suprabhākhyā rasanātiraktā vāmānanasthā bahurūpikā ca|| 12||
pṛ0 81) sutaptacāmīkaracāruvarṇā sthitā hiraṇyā diśi śūlapāṇeḥ| vaidaryya varṇā kanakābhidhānā yā sā niṣaṇā diśi vāsavasya|| 13||
yā raktā taruṇadivākarābhavarṇā sā jihvā hariti susaṃsthitā kṛśānoḥ| yā kṛṣṇā vikasitanīlanīrajābhā sā rajñaḥ parivṛḍha़digvibhāgalagnā|| 14||
padmarāgasadṛśaprabhojjavalā suprabhā varuṇadiśyavasthitā| yā mahārajatapuṣpasannibhā gandhavāhadiśi sātiraktikā|| 15||
yathārthasaṃjñā bahurūpikā yā jihvottare dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā sā| kuṇḍasya madhye tvatha sā praśastā jiṃhvā hiraṇyā bhuvi kārmaṇādau|| 16||
stambhanādiṣu matā kanakākhyā dveṣaṇādiṣu matā khalu raktā| māraṇe nigaditā bhuvi kṛṣṇā suprabhā badhavarairiha śāntyām || 17||
uccāṭane'tiraktā yā bahurūpottare siddhim | ṛddhiṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sā tanute madhye śubhāni sadā|| 18||
anye tvāgamapāragāmaladhiyaḥ prāhurbudhāḥ suprabhām vṛtrāreḥ kakubhi sthitāṃ pitṛpateḥ kṛṣṇāṃ hiraṇyāṃ punaḥ| vāruṇyāṃ bahurūpikāṃ purabhido raktāmudīcyāṃ śritāmāgneyyāmatiraktikāñca kanakāṃ kuṇḍasyamadhye sthitām|| 19||
jihvāntu hiraṇyākhyāṃ śāntikarmaṇi tathā kanakākhyām| raktāṃ kārmaṇakarmaṇi kṛṣṇāṃ kṣudrakriyāsu budhaḥ|| 20||
tatra yogapīṭhamarbhyarcya paścāddevasya devyāśca dadyādācamanādikam| jvālayenmanu nānena tnamagnimatha deśikaḥ| oṃ cit piṅgala hana hana daha daha paca paca sarvāṅgāni jñāpaya svāhā| agniṃ prajvalitaṃ vande jātavedo hutāśanam | suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvato mukham | upatiṣṭheta vidhinā manunānena pāvakam | vinya sedātmano dehe mantrairjihvāhavirbhujaḥ| liṅgapāyuśirīvaktadhrāṇanetreṣu sarvataḥ| vahnirarghīśasaṃyuktāḥ sādivarṇāḥ savindavaḥ| tena syūṃ dhruṃ śruṃ lvuṃ yyu- marṇāmantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā jihvāgreḥ saptadeśikaiḥ| pūrvoktahṛnmantreṇa garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīntonnayanajāta karmaṇāṃ pratyekaṃ saptāhutīḥ kṛtvā tatra gāyatrānuṣṭav vṛhatī paṃkti triṣṭuv jagatīcchandīmaya saptadhātum|| 8|| gārhapatyāhavanīya dakṣiṇāgnimayaṃ tripādaṃ yajamānaṃ pratyātmakaṃ dviśīrṣaṃ catuḥ śṛṅgam | vedacatuṣṭayaṃ catuḥskandhaṃ prātarmadhyāhnasāyamiti śavalatrayabaddhaśarīraṃ vedālokāya pañcarātrabauddhārddharddham | havyasyātmakaṃ vinā puṃsavanatrayeṣu ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvātmakaṃ catuḥśrītraṃ jaṅgamadīpyamānavapuṣaṃ vṛṣendrapṛṣṭhena gataṃ vṛṣendrasya pṛṣṭhagataṃ tathālambitakapālam , adhaḥ dakṣiṇabhāgaiśvaturbhujaiḥ śakti vījaṃ sruksruvau| vāmakaraistribhistrīmaratālavṛntaṃ taghṛrṇapūsauvarṇapātrañca dadhānamityādi|| 9 -11|| jātavedasaṃ dhyātvārghya pādyādidhūpadīpāntairupacārairabhyarcya tataḥ prāgagrairudagagrairdarbhairekamekhalākuṇḍe mekhalādhastāt| dvimekhale dvayormadhye trimekhale mekhalāyāṃ paristīryya yadi sthaṇḍile tadā dakṣiṇottarapaścima bhāgeṣu trīn paridhīn vinyasya paviṣicya tatī garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ punaḥ| anantaraṃ jātakarma syānnāmakaraṇaṃ tathā|
pṛ0 82) yā suprabheti gaditā tāmāhurmokṣakāriṇīṃ jihvām| atiraktāmākṛṣṭau bahurūpāmakhilasiddhidāṃ jihvām || 21||
sarvālaṅkaraṇānvitāṃ sarvakarmasvevaṃ rūpaṃ sādhakaścitrabhānum | samyagdhyāyet saptajihvābhiryuktaṃ jñātvā vāgyatottānavaktam || 22||
kuryyānmantrī jātakarmāvasāne pādyārghyādyai rarcayitvā yathāvat| hṛnmantreṇājyāhutīḥ sapta kṛtvā śrīmannāmāmuṣya dhūmadhvajasya|| 23||
prāgagrairudagagraiḥ paristadedatha kuśaiḥ samyak | ekamekhalakuṇḍe niśitamatirmekhalādhastāt|| 24||
paristared dvimekhale dvitīyamekhalopari| trimekhale tu madhyamekhalopari paṃristaret|| 25||
sthaṇḍilake sikatānāmagre pārśve'tha vinyaset paridhīn | kuṇḍasya dakṣiṇottarapaścimabhāgeṣu sādhako matimān|| 26||
hotuḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvabhāgaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ savyaṃ bhāgaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bhāgamagneḥ| vāmaṃ vidyāduttaraṃ bhāgamagrāṃ prajñāvadbhiḥ paścimaṃ bhāgamuktam || 27||
tato vāmabhāge paristīryya darbhān pulomātmajāvallabhāśāgatāgrān| tadūrddhe nyased dvandvarūpeṇa pātrāṇyatho'dhogatāsyāni sarvāṇi dhīmān|| 28||
sauvarṇāṇyapi rājatānyapi tathā pātrāṇi śaulvāni vā mṛtpātrāṇyapi śāntikādiṣu paraṃ śastāni karmasviha | śelvakṣadrumaśigrū bhūruhakṛtānye tāni vidveṣaṇoccāṭocchādanamāraṇādiṣu bhṛśaṃ śastāni pātrāṇyapi || 29||
pṛ0 83) athottāniteṣveṣu pātreṣu vidvān jalenaikamāpūryya tīrthāni tatra| susañjintya taiḥ prokṣayet kūrcadarbhai stadā savyabhāgasthitaṃ dravyajātam || 30||
kṛtaghṛtaśuddhiḥ pravimalabuddhirju huyādāhutisaptakamatra| annaprāśanamathūḍa़opanayanayorapi vidadhītettham|| 31||
godānamaṅgalādiṣu sarveṣu sahṛdayena| tenaiva samāvarttanavivāhayorāhutīrju huyāt|| 32||
asūniti susaṃskṛte kṛśānau vidhinā pūrvasamīritāsanaṃ tat| parikalpā yathāvadarccayettāṃ parivāreṇa sahāmbikāmathātra|| 33||
parivārasyaikaikāṃ devyāśca daśāhutīrju huyāt | evaṃ bhairavyagnirjanitaḥ syāddhomamācaretātha|| 34||
pālāśairmadhuratrayeṇa kusumaiḥ siktairaśeśānnaraḥ kāmāṃścabhyakapāṭalāvicikilaiḥ prāpnoti homaśriyam | rājyaṃ vilvadalaiḥ phalairapi tathā sāmānyamambhoruhai vāyuḥ śāhvalapallavaiḥ saha guḍa़aiḥ śāntiṃ sahānnaistilaiḥ|| 35||
aghoreṇa draviṇaṃ vigadatvaṃ prāpyācca siddhārthaiḥ| prītiṃ priyaṅgupatraiḥ putrān saukhyaṃ phalairmanujāḥ|| 36||
lājaiḥ saubhāgyaṃ dhānyahomena homāt puṣpairyakṣalokādhipatyam | marttyaḥ punnāgairatividyādharatvam puṣpairmālatyāḥ siddhagandharvalokān || 37||
upaniṣkamaṇaṃ paścādannaprāśanamīritam | cauḍa़īpanayane bhūyo mahānagnimahāvratamityādi| prayogānte maṅgalanāmno'gnergarbhādhānaṃ karomi namaḥ svāhā ityādi| tathāca śataṃ maṅgalanāmānaṃ kuṇḍe'gnisthāpanaṃ tatheti | uttare siddhimiti dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā sā uttare madhye ca ṛddhiṃ siddhiñca tanute| śrīmannāmeti amuṣya dhamadhvajasya vahneḥ śrīmannāmāsi maṅgalānāmāsīti śāradātilake rāghavabhaṭṭaḥ| paridhīniti prādeśadvayaparimitayajñīyakāṣṭhaṃ śeluḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ śīta
pṛ0 84) ākṛṣṭiryakṣiṇīnāṃ trimadhurasahitairarjunaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ syād veśyā vaśyā bhaveyurhayaripukusumaiḥ kiṃśukaiścāpi homāt| vaśyāḥ syuḥ karṇikārairatha dharaṇisurāḥ kṣatriyāḥ kāsamardairvaiśyānāṃ kiṅkirātairgaṇa iha vaśagaḥ pāṭalābhaiśca śūdrāḥ|| 38||
chāgalāṅgajajāṅgalahomāt pararāṣṭraṃ svavaśaṃ bhavedaśeṣam| athavārivalaṃ parāṅnukhaṃ syānmadhurāktena mahāpalalenavāpi || 39||
kaṭutrayapatranimbakeśaiḥ saguḍa़airnārapalānvitairniśāsu | kaṭutailavimiśritaiśca homādarayāstrimunivāsarān mriyante|| 40||
nagnajidasthyajaro haridrākaṇḍanakairvihitaḥ kila homaḥ| saptadināt pratipatranṛpāṇāṃ stambhanakṛt prabalasya balasya|| 41||
māṣairmūkatvaṃ kodravairvyādhibādhām ātaṅgārttiḥ syāt kalāyaistu homāt| unmattaḥ syādakṣajābhiḥ samidbhirmṛtyuḥ saptāhācchālmalīvṛkṣajābhiḥ|| 42||
kapilāghṛtasaṃyutairmanuṣyo yavagodhūmatilaiḥ ṣaḍa़srakuṇḍe | niyutaṃ khacaratvameti hutvā niśi cāreṇa samāhitāntarātmā|| 43||
palāśasya kāṣṭhaiḥ parijvālya havyāsanaṃ candanāmbū kṣitairbandhujīvaiḥ| samastāni bhūtāni vaśyāni homādbhaveyuḥ priyaṅuprasūtaiśca tadvat|| 44||
pṛ0 85) naro bhakṣyabhojyānnapānāni hutvā parāṃ sampadāṃ prāpnuyādatra loke| vaṭoḍumbarādyaṅkuraiḥ svāduvargānvitaiḥ kalyatāṃ mallikārbhiryaśaḥ syāt|| 45||
tuṣṭirnīlāmbu jairhomāt syādacireṇa svaśaktimupetum | ghṛtāhutiguṇitaṣoḍa़śāṅgulonnatirvarā tata iha madhyamārddhataḥ|| 46||
gajāṅgulonnatiradhamā tilodbhavaṃ tatheva mādhvikamapi pañcagavyayuka| ekaṃ bullakaṃ payaso dadhno rasamaikṣavañca tadvat|| 47||
ekaikāpūpalikāpāya samakṣa pramāṇañca| kadalīphalamekaikaṃ nāgaraṅga mātuluṅgañca|| 48||
yanasaṃ daśakhaṇḍaṃ syād guṇakhaṇḍaṃ syāt phalaṃ vailvam | karkaṭikāguṇakhaṇḍāt dalapuṣpāphalānyakhaṇḍāni|| 49||
caturaṅguṣṭhasamānavyañjanapiṇyāka kṛśarāśca| culvākārddhāhi tilāḥ prasūtimitāḥ śaktavo gatitāḥ|| 50||
lājāḥ syurmuṣṭimitāḥ karṣārddhāḥ sarṣapāḥ proktāḥ| karṣapratimā mudgā māṣāśca vrīhayo muṣṭimitāḥ|| 51||
ṣoḍa़śanarapatimāṣā godhūmāśca raktaśālayastadvat| saptāṣṭau vātha vā yavāḥ pañcaśo bhaṇitāḥ|| 52||
arddhapalaṃ guḍa़mānaṃ muṣṭyarddhaṃ taṇḍulāḥ proktāḥ| kuṅkuma mṛgamada candanaghana sārāścanaka mātrāḥ syuḥ|| 53||
uddālo bahuvārakaḥ ityamaraḥ kṣudramaṃśātā iti yasya prasiddhiḥ| drasvaśākhaḥ śiphaḥ kṣupa ityamaraḥ| śigruḥ śailaja iti khyāte| vicikilaḥ puṣpaviśeṣaḥ bandhu jīva iti kecit | kāsamardaiḥ kālakāsundāpuṣpaiḥ| kiñcirātaḥ puṣpaviśeṣaḥ chāgalāṅgajaṃ chāgamāṃsaṃ jaṅgalo dravyaviśeṣaḥ pūrvavat| athaveti arivalaṃ śatrubalaṃ parāṅnukhaṃ syāt madhurāktena mahāpalalaṃ mahāmāṃsam ateva vaidyoktaśāstre brāhmaṇe ca tathā taile māṃse cetyādiṣu mahacchabdo na dīyate , tathā, kaṭutrayanimbapatrakeśairnārapalānbitaiḥ naramāṃsai rhomāt avayaḥ trisaptavāsarāt ekaviṃśatidivasāt prāk mriyante| tathā nagrajidasthi kārpāsabījaṃ kecidrudrākṣaphalam ajaloma haridrākhaṇḍana kairvihito homaḥ saptāhāt pravi pratipakṣanṛpāṇāṃ stambhanakṛt prabalasya māṃsahomāt sukaram | akṣajāvaheḍa़āsamiddhiḥ niśicāreṇa iḍa़āyāṃ vāyau gate|| 12 - 44|| dravyaparimāṇamāha | ghṛtāhutidviguṇitaṣoḍa़śāṅgulonnatiḥ dvātriṃśadaṅgulonnatighṛtaṃ dhārā evambhūtā āhutirvarā śreṣṭhā arddhena madhyaṃ tathā tolodbhavaṃ tailaṃ mākṣikaṃ
pṛ0 86) vadaraphalapramāṇaṃ puraṃ dvikhaṇḍaṃ kapitthaphalakam | śleṣmātakaṃ piśācataruṃ tyaktānyebhyaḥ samīharet samithaḥ|| 54||
gopucchamīṣikāṃśca tyaktānyatṛṇaṃ paristaraṇam | edhāṃsi hiraṇyāyāṃ caruṇāghārāṃśca kanakāyām || 55||
bahurūpāyāṃ juhuyāt siddhārtha vaiṇavāṃśca raktāyām | kṛṣṇāyāmiha lājān śaktūn vaiśuprabhāyāñca|| 56||
atiraktāyāṃ tu tilān sarvadravyāṇi kanakāyāṃ vahneḥ| karṇe home vyādhibādhā netre'ndhaṃ nāsikāyāñca vyādhiḥ|| 57||
dravyacchedo mastake syānmukhāntarhomaṃ kuryyāttena nityaṃ vipaścit| 58||
bherīvāraṇavāraridadhvaninibho vahne rdhvaniḥ śobhanovarṇaḥ svarṇanibhaḥ śubhodayakaraḥ sindūravarṇaḥ samam| udyad bhāskara sannibhaśca ghusṛṇakṣaudre ndragopāruṇo gandhaścampa kapāṭalāvicikilairājyena tulyo'pi ca || 59||
pṛ0 87) punnāganāga keśaraguggulugandhopamaśca siddhikaraḥ| chatrākārā tu śikhā śikhinaḥ śubhadātha kalpanā ca bhavet|| 60||
dhūmo'gneḥ kundanibhaḥ śubhaphaladaḥ kāśakusumasaṅkāśaḥ| kharavāyasaravasadṛśo vahneḥ śabdo vināśakaraḥ|| 61||
kṛṣṇo hutavahavarṇo yajamānaṃ nāśayedacirāt| piṅgo vahurogakaro raupyābho rāṣṭrahānimapi tanuyāt|| 62||
viṣṭhāsadṛśo gandho vahnerduḥ khāni vidadhāti| mūtrasamo balahāniṃ svedaje śubhavināśanaṃ kuryyāt || 63||
vicchinnāgne rmṛtyuṃ śikhā suvṛttā karoti balahānim | śukapicchābho dhūmo vahnervāhānihāśu nāśayati|| 64||
kuryyāt kapotasadṛśaḥ kṛpīṭayonirgavāṃ nāśam | āvarttaḥ śubhaphaladaḥ pradakṣiṇo vītihotrasya|| 65||
vidyutpāte dardure visphuliṅge ānarthyaṃ syāddhomakāle kṛśānoḥ| vāmāvartto vigraho hāsayukte hoturbhītiḥ sambhavedbhūtasaṅghāt || 66||
